````markdown
`si_p2_yaml <installation> <stage>` is the only way a stage reaches a file, and it writes each file with `test_render.py`'s own rewriters, the ones the render tests hold the files to: for `network`, `p2_overlay_text` edits the overlay `k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml` (`clickhouse.access.engineGrants`, `clickhouse.server.enabled`, `clickhouse.access.member` and `clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.si_member`, every other line kept); for `indexer-b` and `indexer-c`, `p2_manifest_text` rewrites the CHI manifest line by line, comments included: each creating user's `TABLE ENGINE` grants, the four bundle files (indexer-c keeps its own `zz-si-storage.xml` of Plan S3-B Task 19) with `zz-pool-settings.xml` at a fetch pool of 16, the reader environment of the `clickhouse` container, the stage-3 P2 lines at the end of the posture comment, and the `si_member` user and profile, each from that stage on; for `staging-p2`, `p2_staging_chi` writes `$si_backup/staging-chi-<stage>.yaml` from the committed `docs/examples/storage-integrity-p2-staging-chi.yaml` with the staging hashes for every user. Before it writes, each result is checked against an independent construction: a manifest must parse to `p2_chi(...)` of the old one (the same CHI built from the constants) and must not change when rewritten again, and the overlay must parse to the old one with exactly the stage's four values. Rolling back is the same call with the earlier stage. For a live installation it then sets that CHI's `DEVNET2_P2_STAGE` entry in `test_render.py`, and, at the first commit from `engines` on, `DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES` to the census's `ENGINE_CENSUS`; afterwards the constant itself is the engine set (§14.2 adds a missing engine there). Each constant edit is a no-op when the entry already holds the value. So the render tests (`test_p2_stage_rewrites_reach_every_stage_and_back`, `test_p2_server_bundle_files_are_identical_across_installations_by_role`, `test_devnet2_p2_stage_follows_the_rollout`) hold at every stage by construction.

`si_p2_stage_check <host> <stage>` reads back what the stage must have done, as `default`, and never copies a file out of the pod: the preprocessed `config.xml` holds the reader passwords that `from_env` substituted, so only a `grep -c` of the access-control line runs on it. Before `restarted` it expects no fence, no P2 file, `background_fetches_pool_size` 8, no named collection, the merge default untouched and no disk `member` (indexer-c's, from Plan S3-B Task 19, aside); from `restarted` on the fence, the five files with one `from_env` per collection, `background_fetches_pool_size` 16, both disks with `keep_free_space` = `DEVNET2_KEEP_FREE_SPACE_BYTES`, the disk `member` at the installation's path and the policy `member` on it alone, `max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool` 0 for replicated tables, and exactly the installation's collections (the network installation's on all four of its pods, K43). It prints the member disk's `total_space` and the uptime.

`si_p2_host_unchanged <x>` proves that starting a member left its host alone, with or without §8's baseline: the host pod and each of its containers started before the member's StatefulSet was created and none restarted since, the pod runs its StatefulSet's current revision, which is also the update revision, and, when §8's baseline file exists, the pod's uid and restart count and the StatefulSet's generation and revisions equal it. `si_p2_sealed` is the leader's sealed tip as an integer (Prometheus prints large values in exponent form).

`si_quiet_point <owner>` is the condition every restart window starts from (contract §27.5): it reads the owner's partition states with the stage-3 P0 runbook's `partstates` (every partition's `unacked_promotion_seq` 0), the leader's sealed block and safe watermark (no sealed block above it, on any track), the active Jobs (none of `<release>-si-backup` or of a P1 drill) and the owner's inactive `hg_safe` parts (none: Plan S3-B runbook §13.3, so no `REPLACE`-retired part can come back with the restart). It waits up to 10 minutes and names the condition that held it up. `si_restart_watch <CHI> <state file>` follows one restart: it polls the CHI and its pods every 10 seconds until each pod of the installation has been replaced or restarted and is Ready and the CHI is Completed, keeps every poll in `$si_backup/restart-watch-<CHI>.txt`, and prints how many restarts it saw per pod; each must be 1.

`si_member_probe <host>` runs `charts/storage-integrity/tests/si_member_live_probe.tsv`, the refusal-only subset of the grant-probe corpus, as `si_member` against the live collections of that host's installation (`@@COLLECTION@@` becomes the installation's first collection in `DEVNET2_NAMED_COLLECTIONS`: `si_owner_1` on `a`, `v1`, `v2` and `v3`, `si_owner_0` on `b` and `c`; a row naming `si_owner_staging` is refused before anything runs). It first creates `hg_rstage` and `hg_replica` as `si_member` where they do not exist, because a refused `CREATE TABLE` in a missing database would answer 81 before the access check; it records every row (`ok`, `denied` for 497, `override` for 36 `Override not allowed for '<key>'`), requires a refused `CREATE TABLE … ENGINE = <X>` to name `TABLE ENGINE ON <X>`, drops as `default` any `p2_probe` object a row created after all, and at the end drops a database it created only where no si-member runs. Its first run on a host writes `member-probe-<host>.tsv` (§7.4), its second `exit-probe-<host>.tsv` (§12); a third refuses. It writes on the host, so every call sits in a confirmed block.

`si_budget_capture` and `si_budget` are Plan S3-B runbook §13.4's two blocks as merged on housegate `main` in housegate#237 (`838de2d`), verbatim: the newest finished snapshot of the leader's store, checked against its metadata's size and CRC, gives the state size and `promotion_seq`; the live sequence is read after it; the budget to L/4 fits S = a·n² through that snapshot and subtracts every promotion made since. `arbiter_state_bytes` is never paired with a live sequence.

`si_blockowners` runs the throwaway tool `blockowners` (never committed) inside the leader's arbiter container, like the stage-3 P0 runbook's `partstates`: `si_blockowners_build` extracts its source below (the only go block of this file) into a `git archive` export of arbiter-core at `CORE_TAG_P2` and builds it for linux/amd64; `si_blockowners_put` copies it into the three voters' arbiter containers, a write that runs only in a confirmed block of its own; `si_blockowners` refuses a missing or stale copy. For every block of a range it prints `block_seq`, `owner` (the block's track), `transition` (a table-set transition, which the shadow verifier skips), `verdict_evaluated` and `quorum`, read through `dataplane.Client.GetBlockVerification` (Plan S3-C2 contract §21.1), which follows the leader and checks that the answer is the block asked for.

`si_shadow_sample` reads every member's shadow counters, copy entries and member disk use into one TSV line per (member, peer owner), without a header: time (UTC, RFC 3339), member, owner, shadowed blocks, mismatches (every kind), missed scans, unverdicted, copy behind seconds, the copy entry's safe block and applied promotion, the shadow's next block and the member disk's used ratio; `soak.tsv` is such lines appended, and `soak-start` and `soak-end` are `KEY=VALUE` records (`SOAK_START_UTC`, `SOAK_START_SEALED`, `SOAK_START_REGISTRY_VERSION`, `SOAK_K`, `SOAK_B`, `SOAK_L0`; `SOAK_END_UTC`, `SOAK_END_SEALED`) that a bash block reads with `source`; `si_copies_check` compares every member's copy entry per peer owner with that owner's latest published frontier. `si_p2_py` holds the checks behind them (subcommands `census`, `stage`, `engines`, `constant`, `member`, `monitoring`, `check`, `grants`, `sample`, `round`, `copies`, `probe-file`, `soak`); it imports this checkout's `test_render.py` constants, so the reviewed values are read from one place.

The source of `blockowners`, which `si_blockowners_build` compiles as `cmd/blockowners/main.go`:

```go
// blockowners is the throwaway reader of docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md
// (production), never committed. si_blockowners_build compiles it from a
// git archive export of arbiter-core at CORE_TAG_P2, as cmd/blockowners/main.go,
// for linux/amd64; si_blockowners_put copies it into the voters' arbiter
// containers and si_blockowners runs the leader's copy against the voters'
// data-plane listeners (grpc_listen :7080, plaintext gRPC like every
// data-plane client).
//
// For every L3 block from -from to -to it reads the leader's
// SafeState.GetBlockVerification through arbiter-core's
// dataplane.Client.GetBlockVerification (Plan S3-C2 contract §21.1) and prints
// one JSON line: the block's sequence, the SI indexer whose track it belongs
// to, whether it is a table-set transition (the shadow verifier skips those),
// whether its verdict was evaluated and whether that verdict reached quorum.
// It refuses a block without a track (before the tracks activation) and stops
// at the first block that is not sealed. It writes nothing anywhere.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane"
)

// blockLine is one block's owner and verdict, the fields the P2 runbook's
// soak and restart-window checks read (Plan S3-C3 contract §27.2).
type blockLine struct {
	BlockSeq         uint64 `json:"block_seq"`
	Owner            uint64 `json:"owner"`
	Transition       bool   `json:"transition"`
	VerdictEvaluated bool   `json:"verdict_evaluated"`
	Quorum           bool   `json:"quorum"`
}

func main() {
	peers := flag.String("peers", "", "every voter as id=host:port, comma-separated")
	from := flag.Uint64("from", 0, "the first L3 block sequence to read (at least 1)")
	to := flag.Uint64("to", 0, "the last L3 block sequence to read (at least -from)")
	timeout := flag.Duration("timeout", 5*time.Minute, "deadline of the whole run")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := run(*peers, *from, *to, *timeout); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "blockowners:", err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func parsePeers(list string) ([]dataplane.Peer, error) {
	var out []dataplane.Peer
	for _, item := range strings.Split(list, ",") {
		id, addr, ok := strings.Cut(strings.TrimSpace(item), "=")
		if !ok || id == "" || addr == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("-peers entry %q is not id=host:port", item)
		}
		out = append(out, dataplane.Peer{ID: id, GRPCAddr: addr})
	}
	return out, nil
}

func run(peerList string, from, to uint64, timeout time.Duration) error {
	if peerList == "" {
		return errors.New("-peers is required")
	}
	if from == 0 || to < from {
		return fmt.Errorf("need 1 <= -from <= -to, got -from %d -to %d", from, to)
	}
	peers, err := parsePeers(peerList)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	c, err := dataplane.New(dataplane.Config{Peers: peers})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer c.Close()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), timeout)
	defer cancel()

	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	owners := map[uint64]int{}
	for seq := from; seq <= to; seq++ {
		v, err := c.GetBlockVerification(ctx, seq)
		if errors.Is(err, dataplane.ErrBlockNotSealed) {
			return fmt.Errorf("block %d is not sealed (the range must end at or below the sealed tip): %w", seq, err)
		}
		if err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("GetBlockVerification(%d): %w", seq, err)
		}
		if v.Header.TrackIndexerID == nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("block %d has no track: it was sealed before the tracks activation", seq)
		}
		line := blockLine{
			BlockSeq:         v.Header.L3BlockSeq,
			Owner:            *v.Header.TrackIndexerID,
			Transition:       v.Header.IsTableSetTransition,
			VerdictEvaluated: v.VerdictEvaluated,
			Quorum:           v.Quorum,
		}
		if err := enc.Encode(line); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		owners[line.Owner]++
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "blockowners: blocks %d to %d: %d blocks, per owner %v\n", from, to, to-from+1, owners)
	return nil
}
```

The member image runs only in the si-member StatefulSets of §8; no SNode, verifier or voter changes image in P2, and a member can always be turned off (§13). The values also live in the stage-3 plans' release ledger (Appendix C of each plan file on housegate), which the next block reads with the ledger tool `$HOME/.cache/s3-ledger/s3-ledger.py` (Plan S3-C1 contract §19) and compares with the pins above; it also needs Plan S3-C2's integration record (K38) and that nothing of this runbook is recorded yet. Set the four local clones (any clones with the release tags; the block only fetches from them and reads), then:

```bash

CORE_TAG_P2='<CORE_TAG_P2>'; SN_COMMIT_P2='<SN_COMMIT_P2>'; SN_DIGEST_P2='<SN_DIGEST_P2>'; INDEXER_C_ID='<INDEXER_C_ID>'

[ -r "$ledger" ] || { echo "the ledger tool $ledger is missing: write it from Plan S3-C1 contract §19 first"; exit 1; }

python3 -I "$ledger" get "$housegate_repo" ARBITER_TAG ARBITER_DIGEST SN_COMMIT SN_DIGEST OPERATOR_CHART_VERSION INDEXER_C_ID E_END P1_END CORE_TAG_P2 P2_CONFINEMENT SN_COMMIT_P2 SN_DIGEST_P2 ARBITER_PIN_P2 P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK P2_PR MEMBER_IDS | tee "$si_backup/ledger-values.txt"

for v in ARBITER_TAG ARBITER_DIGEST SN_COMMIT SN_DIGEST CORE_TAG_P2 SN_COMMIT_P2 SN_DIGEST_P2 INDEXER_C_ID; do
  grep -qxF "$v=${!v}" "$si_backup/ledger-values.txt" || { echo "the ledger's $v is not this runbook's pin ${!v}: stop"; exit 1; }
done
grep -qxF "MEMBER_IDS=member-a:0,member-b:1,member-c:$INDEXER_C_ID" "$si_backup/ledger-values.txt" || { echo "MEMBER_IDS is not member-a:0,member-b:1,member-c:$INDEXER_C_ID: stop"; exit 1; }

[[ "$soak" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$soak" -ge 500 ] || { echo "P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK is '$soak', not at least 500: Plan S3-C2 Task 36's release-path full soak has not passed (K38, D38); stop"; exit 1; }
git -C "$arbiter_core_repo" fetch -q --tags origin; git -C "$sentio_node_repo" fetch -q origin; git -C "$arbiter_repo" fetch -q origin

[ "$(docker buildx imagetools inspect "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-$SN_COMMIT" | sed -n 's/^Digest: *//p')" = "$SN_DIGEST" ] || { echo "the host image digest is not $SN_DIGEST"; exit 1; }

| `si_owner_1` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source` | `SI_READER_PASSWORD_INDEXER_B` | network, indexer-c |
| `si_owner_<INDEXER_C_ID>` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-source` | `SI_READER_PASSWORD_INDEXER_C` | network, indexer-b |
| `si_peer_verifier_1`, `si_peer_verifier_2`, `si_peer_verifier_3` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-verifier-<n>` | `SI_READER_PASSWORD_NETWORK` | network, indexer-b, indexer-c |
| `si_owner_staging` | `storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-source` | `SI_READER_PASSWORD_STAGING` | staging-p2 only |

Secrets, all in `sentio-network-devnet2`:

| Secret | Keys | Made by | Read by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-network`, `-indexer-b`, `-indexer-c` | `clickhouse-password` (the `si_member` password of that installation) | the user's `make-p2-logins.sh` (below) | the host's `si-member` container only (`STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD`); `si_member_ch` |
| `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-member-status-token`, `-b-`, `-c-` | `status-token` | the user's `make-p2-logins.sh` | the host's `si-member` container (the P2 image ignores it; stage 3 P3's serving listener checks it) and, from P3, the host pod's `sentio-node` container; never the Secret that holds the `si_member` password (D29) |
| `storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-logins` | `default`, `si_backup`, `si_gateway`, `si_member`, `si_reader`, `si_snode`, `si_verifier` | the user's `make-p2-logins.sh staging-p2` | the staging installation's `SI_READER_PASSWORD_STAGING` (key `si_reader`); `si_p2s_ch` |
| `storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-reader-network`, `-indexer-b`, `-indexer-c` | `password` (`si_reader`'s) | the stage-3 lockdown | the ClickHouse containers' reader environment from each installation's `restarted` stage |
| `storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-a`, `-b`, `-c` | `access-id`, `secret` (read-only restore keys) | stage 3 P1 | the host's `si-member` container (`STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET`) |

The identities and the member disks, read-only. The member disk of `member-a` and `member-b` is the directory `/var/lib/clickhouse/disks/member/` of the data volume, created by the restart of §5; `member-c`'s is the volume `member-volume-claim` at `/var/lib/clickhouse-member/` (K40). ClickHouse reports a disk's total as its filesystem's size less `keep_free_space_bytes` (measured on 26.3: `system.disks.total_space` and `DiskTotal_<disk>` both), so the value recorded here is what `DiskTotal_member` will read, and it is each member's `disk_budget_bytes` (decision D28; §8 checks it against the live value):

```bash
{
  si_kubectl get pods -o wide | grep -E '^(storage-integrity-si-v2-(source|verifier-[123]|indexer-b-source|indexer-c-source)-0-0-0|sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-[abc]-0|storage-integrity-si-v2-(arbiter|verifier)-[012]) '
  for h in a v1 v2 v3 b c; do printf '%s ' "$h"; si_ch_admin "$h" "SELECT version(), currentUser() FORMAT TSV"; done
  for x in a b c; do si_info "$x"; done
  keep="$(python3 -I -B -c 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "charts/storage-integrity/tests"); import test_render as t; print(int(t.DEVNET2_KEEP_FREE_SPACE_BYTES))')"
  for x in a b c; do
    if [ "$x" = c ]; then path=/var/lib/clickhouse-member; else path=/var/lib/clickhouse; fi
    size="$(si_kubectl exec "$(si_ch_pod "$x")" -c clickhouse -- df -B1 --output=size "$path" | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')"
    [[ "$size" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$size" -gt "$keep" ] || { echo "cannot read the size of $path on $x ($size)"; exit 1; }
    printf '%s\n' "$((size - keep))" > "$si_backup/member-disk-$x"
    echo "member-$x: $path is on a filesystem of $size bytes; DiskTotal_member and disk_budget_bytes = $((size - keep))"
  done
  [ "$(si_ch_admin c "SELECT total_space FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'member'")" = "$(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-c")" ] || { echo "indexer-c's disk member does not report the recorded total: stop"; exit 1; }
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/identities.txt"
```

Expected: the CHI pods, the three hosts and the six arbiter and verifier pods Running; every server `26.3.…` and `default`; `si_info` `a` with `"si_indexer_id":0`, `b` with `1`, `c` with `<INDEXER_C_ID>`, each `"enrolled":true`; one total per member host, indexer-c's equal to its live `DiskTotal_member`.

The hashes files `$si_p2_logins_dir/hashes-<installation>.yaml` hold only `passwordSha256:` (user → SHA-256 hex): `si_member` for `network`, `indexer-b` and `indexer-c`, all seven staging users for `staging-p2`. Hashes are not secret; passwords and tokens never leave their Secrets.

The user, in their own terminal (fish), from the root of the same production checkout, makes every password, token and Secret. Each run creates that installation's Secrets, refuses to overwrite an existing Secret or hashes file, prints no password or token, removes its temporary plaintext, and writes only the hashes file:

```fish
mkdir -p -m 700 $HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins
bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh staging-p2 $HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-staging-p2.yaml
bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh indexer-b $HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-indexer-b.yaml
bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh indexer-c $HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-indexer-c.yaml
bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh network $HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-network.yaml
```

This runbook never runs the script and never reads a password; it checks the results only (key names from `kubectl describe`, never values):

```bash
[ -d "$si_p2_logins_dir" ] && [ -n "$(find "$si_p2_logins_dir" -maxdepth 0 -perm 700)" ] || { echo "$si_p2_logins_dir is not a directory of mode 700: the user creates it (§1.2)"; exit 1; }
for f in staging-p2 indexer-b indexer-c network; do test -s "$si_p2_logins_dir/hashes-$f.yaml" || { echo "missing $si_p2_logins_dir/hashes-$f.yaml: the user runs §1.2's commands first"; exit 1; }; done
python3 -I - "$si_p2_logins_dir" <<'EOF'
import re, sys, yaml
base = sys.argv[1]
want = {"network": {"si_member"}, "indexer-b": {"si_member"}, "indexer-c": {"si_member"},
        "staging-p2": {"default", "si_snode", "si_gateway", "si_verifier", "si_reader", "si_backup", "si_member"}}
seen = {}
for inst, users in want.items():
    hashes = yaml.safe_load(open(f"{base}/hashes-{inst}.yaml"))["passwordSha256"]
    if set(hashes) != users:
        sys.exit(f"{inst}: users {sorted(hashes)}, expected {sorted(users)}")
    for user, value in sorted(hashes.items()):
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", str(value)):
            sys.exit(f"{inst}/{user}: not 64 lowercase hex characters")
        if value in seen:
            sys.exit(f"{inst}/{user} has the same hash as {seen[value]}: two equal passwords")
        seen[value] = f"{inst}/{user}"
        print(f"{inst}\t{user}\t{value}")
EOF
check() { local got; got="$(si_secret_keys "$1")"; [ "$got" = "$2" ] || { echo "Secret $1 has keys '$got', expected '$2'"; return 1; }; echo "$1: $got"; }
{
  for inst in network indexer-b indexer-c; do check "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$inst" "clickhouse-password "; done
  for x in a b c; do check "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$x-si-member-status-token" "status-token "; done
  check storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-logins "default si_backup si_gateway si_member si_reader si_snode si_verifier "
  for inst in network indexer-b indexer-c; do check "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-reader-$inst" "password "; done
  for x in a b c; do check "storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-$x" "access-id secret "; done
} | tee "$si_backup/secrets.txt"
```

Expected: ten hash lines (three `si_member` hashes and seven staging hashes, all distinct), then the fifteen Secrets with exactly their keys: the password Secret of each member holds `clickhouse-password` and nothing else, and its status token sits in a Secret of its own (D29). A Secret made by mistake is deleted by the user and made again, only before §3 has used it.

  python3 -I "$HOME/.cache/s3-ledger/s3-ledger.py" show "$(sed -n 4p "$si_backup/repos")" s3c2 | awk '/^## Appendix C/ {c = 1} c' > "$si_backup/s3c2-appendix-c.md"

Then copy both into the three voters' arbiter containers (`/tmp/partstates`, `/tmp/blockowners`; a write into the pods, nothing else changes; a replaced or restarted voter loses its copies, and the helpers then ask for this block again):

The promotion budget (spec §13.1, K38), read-only. Every write of P2 together spends at most half of it: one acceptance write per restart window (3) and three soak rounds of `k` writes per owner (9k), with `k = min(3, (budget // 2 - 3) // 9)`; P2 does not start unless `k` is at least 1:

```bash
si_budget_capture
si_budget | tee "$si_backup/budget-start.txt"
budget="$(sed -n 's/.*budget to L\/4 ([0-9]* bytes): \([0-9]*\) promotions.*/\1/p' "$si_backup/budget-start.txt")"
[[ "$budget" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "no budget line: stop"; exit 1; }
k=$(( (budget / 2 - 3) / 9 ))
[ "$k" -le 3 ] || k=3
[ "$k" -ge 1 ] || { echo "a budget of $budget promotions: half of it does not cover 3 window writes and 9 soak writes; stop (spec §13.1, K38)"; exit 1; }
echo "budget $budget promotions; P2 writes $((3 + 9 * k)) (3 window writes, 3 rounds of $k per owner), within half ($((budget / 2)))" | tee "$si_backup/budget-plan.txt"
```

Expected: the estimator's line, which `budget-start.txt` holds alone, and `budget <n> promotions; P2 writes <3 + 9k> …` in `budget-plan.txt`. A line ending `stop`: stop. §10 computes `k` again from `budget-start.txt` when the soak starts and records it there.

## 2. Engine census

Read-only. Once an installation restarts with `table_engines_require_grant`, every user creates only the table engines granted to it by name (`TABLE ENGINE ON <engine>`), so before any restart the census finds every engine each user needs (K41). It reads, on every SI ClickHouse: (a) seven days of `system.query_log` rows of kind `Create`, with every `TABLE ENGINE ON <engine>` privilege each statement used (measured on 26.3: the server records the check in `used_privileges` even while the setting is off; a temporary table records `TABLE ENGINE ON Memory`, a materialized view its inner table's engine, `CREATE DATABASE … ENGINE = <X>` records `TABLE ENGINE ON <X>`, and a plain view, a materialized view `TO` a table and a database without `ENGINE` record none); (b) the engine of every existing table outside `system` and `information_schema`, materialized-view inner tables included; and every `Replicated*MergeTree` table with whether it pins `max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool`, because the merge default 0 of §5 changes every replicated table that does not (K39). The P0 runbook's protocol code paths create only `MergeTree` and `ReplicatedMergeTree` (arbiter-core `dataplane/ddl/build.go:46-48,103-118`, housegate `pkg/replay/chexec/materializer.go:115-119`, `snapshot.go:387`), and the bootstrap hook creates its database without `ENGINE` (`charts/storage-integrity/templates/bootstrap-source.yaml:153`).

The check stops on: an engine of `si_snode` or `si_verifier` outside `MergeTree` and `ReplicatedMergeTree`; any `CREATE` by `si_reader` or `si_backup`; a `Replicated*` engine by `si_gateway`; a `CREATE DATABASE … ENGINE = …` by any `si_*` user (26.3 checks it as `TABLE ENGINE ON <engine>`, which `GRANT` cannot name); a user other than `default`, `clickhouse_operator` and the `si_*` users creating anything; an existing table of another engine in `hg_safe`, `hg_unsafe` or `hg_promote`; an existing table in a member database, or one in `default` that is no replay scratch; a tenant table of a reaching engine (`Buffer`, `Distributed`, `Merge`, `Alias`), which `si_gateway` would then have to hold; and any replicated table that is neither a protocol `hg_unsafe` table nor pins `max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool` (the user decides about such a table before P2 goes on). `si_gateway` is then granted `Memory`, `MergeTree` and every tenant engine the census found (its own creates, `default`'s in tenant databases, and the engines of existing tenant tables), sorted: that set is `ENGINE_CENSUS`. `default` and `clickhouse_operator` are users.xml users without `<grants>`, so they keep every engine and are granted nothing.

```bash
: > "$si_backup/engine-census.jsonl"; : > "$si_backup/replicated-tables.tsv"
for h in a v1 v2 v3 b c; do
  [ "$(si_ch_admin "$h" "SELECT min(event_time) <= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY FROM system.query_log")" = 1 ] || { echo "host $h: system.query_log holds less than 7 days: wait, then run §2 again"; exit 1; }
  si_engine_census "$h" > "$si_backup/engine-census-$h.jsonl"
  si_replicated_tables "$h" > "$si_backup/replicated-tables-$h.tsv"
  jq -c --arg h "$h" '. + {host: $h}' "$si_backup/engine-census-$h.jsonl" >> "$si_backup/engine-census.jsonl"
  awk -v h="$h" 'NF {print h "\t" $0}' "$si_backup/replicated-tables-$h.tsv" >> "$si_backup/replicated-tables.tsv"
  echo "host $h: $(wc -l < "$si_backup/engine-census-$h.jsonl" | tr -d ' ') census lines, $(wc -l < "$si_backup/replicated-tables-$h.tsv" | tr -d ' ') replicated tables"
done
si_engine_census_check "$si_backup/engine-census.jsonl" "$si_backup/replicated-tables.tsv" 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/engine-census.txt"
```

Expected: six host lines, then `note:` lines to read (each a tenant replicated table that pins its merges, or an administrator's statement), no `FAIL:` line, `census ok: si_gateway Memory,MergeTree,…` and the last line `ENGINE_CENSUS=<engines>`. Any `FAIL:`: stop. A finding about a protocol user means the code paths above changed: stop and amend the plan. A tenant replicated table without pinned merges, or a tenant table of a reaching engine (`Buffer`, `Distributed`, `Merge`, `Alias`), is the user's decision (drop it, or have its owner pin the setting) before P2 goes on; never grant a `Replicated*` or reaching engine to `si_gateway` without that decision and a plan amendment. `ENGINE_CENSUS` is recorded in this plan's ledger by its live task with §5's end; §4.1 writes it into `test_render.py` as `DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES`.

## 3. Staging proof

The staging installation `storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging` (`docs/examples/storage-integrity-p2-staging-chi.yaml`: indexer-b's posture-C CHI renamed, cluster `source`, the network installation's user set with the staging hashes, the one collection `si_owner_staging` on itself, Keeper root `/storage-integrity/devnet2/p2-staging`, 1Gi volumes, `sentio.xyz/general` nodes) is reconciled by the same `devnet2-operator`. It goes through the four stages exactly as a live installation will, each a `kubectl apply` of `$si_backup/staging-chi-<stage>.yaml` that `si_p2_yaml staging-p2 <stage>` generates from the committed file: `engines` and `member` must restart nothing (users reload), `restarted` must restart the pod exactly once and land the whole bundle. It also measures, on the deployed image, what the live windows rely on: a refused `CREATE TABLE … ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree` leaves no znode (the order of the engine check and the Keeper path creation), and a config-defined collection refuses every override with code 36 `Override not allowed for '<key>'` (Plan S3-A M8 measured the SQL form). Then the grant probe runs the committed corpus, every protocol DDL form after the restart included. Any other outcome stops P2. Its collections never name a live installation, and it is deleted at this section's end.

ClickHouse refuses Keeper operations until its root exists, so the staging root comes first:

Confirm before running.

```bash
si_keeper "touch '$si_p2_staging_root'"
listing="$(si_keeper "ls '$si_p2_staging_root'")"
case "$listing" in *"No node"*|*rror*) echo "the staging Keeper root was not created: $listing"; exit 1 ;; esac
[ -z "$(printf '%s' "$listing" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ] || { echo "the staging Keeper root is not empty ($listing): an earlier staging run left it; run this section's cleanup first"; exit 1; }
echo "staging Keeper root ready"
```

The four variants, local only:

```bash
for s in base engines restarted member; do si_p2_yaml staging-p2 "$s"; done
python3 -I - "$si_backup" <<'EOF'
import sys, yaml
base = sys.argv[1]
docs = {s: yaml.safe_load(open(f"{base}/staging-chi-{s}.yaml")) for s in ("base", "engines", "restarted", "member")}
def strip(d):
    spec = yaml.safe_load(yaml.safe_dump(d["spec"]))
    conf = spec["configuration"]
    for key in ("files", "users", "profiles"):
        conf.pop(key, None)
    for pod in spec["templates"]["podTemplates"]:
        for c in pod["spec"]["containers"]:
            c.pop("env", None)
    return spec
for s, d in docs.items():
    assert d["metadata"]["name"] == "storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging", s
    assert d["spec"]["configuration"]["zookeeper"]["root"] == "/storage-integrity/devnet2/p2-staging", s
    conf = d["spec"]["configuration"]
    print(s, "files:", sorted(conf.get("files") or {}), "users:", sorted({k.split("/")[0] for k in conf["users"]}))
assert all(strip(d) == strip(docs["base"]) for d in docs.values()), "the variants differ outside files, users, profiles and the environment"
print("the variants differ only in files, users, profiles and the reader environment")
EOF
```

Expected: `base` and `engines` with `users.d/zz-si-default-loopback.xml` and `zz-pool-settings.xml` only, `restarted` and `member` with the five server files as well; `member` alone with `si_member`; `the variants differ only in files, users, profiles and the reader environment`.

Stage `base`, the baseline:

Confirm before running.

The measurements on the deployed image after the restart: every protocol DDL form succeeds as its user (`si_gateway`'s `CREATE DATABASE` without `ENGINE`, the bootstrap hook's form, and its `MergeTree` and temporary tables; `si_snode`'s databases, its `ReplicatedMergeTree` in `hg_unsafe`, its `MergeTree` in `hg_safe` and the `hg_promote … AS` form; `si_verifier`'s replay scratch), then a `ReplicatedMergeTree` `CREATE` as `si_gateway` must be refused with 497 before ClickHouse touches Keeper, and each override of `si_owner_staging`'s `host`, `port`, `user` and `password` must be refused with 36. The created tables are dropped again as `default`:

Confirm before running.

```bash
{
  ddl() { local out; out="$(si_p2s_ch "$1" "$2" 2>&1)" || { echo "refused as $1: $2: $out"; return 1; }; echo "ok as $1: $2"; }
  ddl si_gateway "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS devnet2"
  for db in hg_unsafe hg_safe hg_promote; do ddl si_snode "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS $db"; done
  ddl si_snode "CREATE TABLE hg_unsafe.p2_measure_unsafe (v Int64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/sentio/0/unsafe/p2_measure_unsafe', 'snode-measure') ORDER BY tuple()"
  ddl si_snode "CREATE TABLE hg_safe.p2_measure_safe (v Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()"
  ddl si_snode "CREATE TABLE hg_promote.p2_measure_safe AS hg_safe.p2_measure_safe"
  ddl si_verifier "CREATE TABLE default._hg_replay_scratch_p2measure (v Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()"
  ddl si_gateway "CREATE TABLE devnet2.p2_measure (v Int64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()"
  ddl si_gateway "CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE p2_measure_tmp (v Int64)"
  for t in hg_promote.p2_measure_safe hg_safe.p2_measure_safe hg_unsafe.p2_measure_unsafe default._hg_replay_scratch_p2measure devnet2.p2_measure; do si_p2s_ch default "DROP TABLE $t SYNC"; done
  echo "every protocol DDL form succeeded after the restart; its tables are dropped"
  out="$(si_p2s_ch si_gateway "CREATE TABLE devnet2.p2_restart_probe (x UInt8) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/p2-restart-probe/{uuid}', 'r') ORDER BY x" 2>&1)" && { echo "the CREATE was accepted: stop"; si_p2s_ch default "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS devnet2.p2_restart_probe SYNC"; exit 1; }
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -o 'Code: 497.*TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree' || { echo "not a 497 naming TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree: $out"; exit 1; }
  listing="$(si_keeper "ls '$si_p2_staging_root'")"
  echo "staging root after the refused CREATE: $listing"
  case "$listing" in *p2-restart-probe*) echo "the refused CREATE left a znode: the restart windows' probe must not run on live hosts; stop"; exit 1 ;; esac
  for key in "host = 'elsewhere'" "port = 9001" "user = 'default'" "password = 'x'"; do
    out="$(si_p2s_ch default "SELECT * FROM remote(si_owner_staging, $key, database = 'system', table = 'one')" 2>&1)" && { echo "the override $key was accepted: stop"; exit 1; }
    printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -o "Code: 36.*Override not allowed for '[a-z]*'" || { echo "the override $key was not refused with 36: $out"; exit 1; }
  done
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/staging-measurements.txt"
```

Expected (the refusals measured on `clickhouse/clickhouse-server:26.3` (26.3.51.7) while this runbook was written): ten `ok as <user>: …` lines and `every protocol DDL form succeeded after the restart; its tables are dropped`; then `Code: 497. … To execute this query, it's necessary to have the grant TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree`, a staging root without `p2-restart-probe` (the engine check runs before the Keeper path is created; and since `{uuid}` without an explicit UUID is refused with 36 after the check, the probe can create nothing even where the engine were granted), then `Override not allowed for 'host'`, `'port'`, `'user'` and `'password'` with code 36. A refused protocol form means a user lacks an engine the census missed: stop (§14.2 grants it by name in a reviewed change, never by turning the setting off). Anything else: stop.

listing="$(si_keeper "ls '$si_p2_staging_root/sentio/0'")"
case " $listing " in *" unsafe_inc "*) echo "staging unsafe_inc ready" ;; *) echo "staging unsafe_inc was not created: $listing"; exit 1 ;; esac
```

Confirm before running.

Expected: `host staging-p2: system.grants is stage member's: … si_member with <n> rows, every other row unchanged` (the sixteen grants of `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS` and `NAMED COLLECTION ON si_owner_staging`, `READ ON REMOTE` and no `WRITE`), no `diff` output, `stage member ok on staging-p2` and `si_member logs in`.

The grant probe: every row of `charts/storage-integrity/tests/clickhouse_grant_probe.tsv` for the roles of the staging installation, in order, as its role (`ok` means no 497, `denied` 497, `override` 36 `Override not allowed for '<key>'`; a login or network error is a failed row, and a `default` row, the corpus's setup and teardown of the probe objects, must succeed outright). It covers every grant of `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS` and every collection grant, the refusals of spec §8.2 and §17 for `si_member` (the eight `Replicated*MergeTree` engines and `Buffer`, `Distributed`, `Merge` and `Alias` in `hg_rstage` and `hg_replica`, a `Replicated` database, `ATTACH PARTITION … FROM`, `MOVE PARTITION … TO TABLE` and a materialized view into `hg_member_unsafe`, writes, partition drops, truncates and optimizes there, `INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote(…)`, `SYSTEM DROP REPLICA … FROM ZKPATH`, a dictionary, a definer view, `SYSTEM` in `hg_rstage`), the four overrides, and every protocol DDL form after the restart (`si_snode`'s `ReplicatedMergeTree` in `hg_unsafe`, `MergeTree` in `hg_safe` and the `hg_promote … AS` form, `si_verifier`'s replay scratch, `si_gateway`'s `CREATE DATABASE` without `ENGINE`, a `MergeTree` table and a temporary table; `si_gateway`'s `ReplicatedMergeTree` and `si_snode`'s `SummingMergeTree` refused). `si_backup`'s rows run too (from the restart on its temporary table is refused, since `si_backup` holds no engine, K41); `si_restore` exists only on the P1 staging installation, so its rows are skipped and counted. It runs DDL and DML on the staging installation only:

Confirm before running.

```bash
si_p2s_grant_probe | tee "$si_backup/grant-probe-staging-p2.tsv"
awk -F'\t' 'NR > 1 {print $2, $3, $4}' "$si_backup/grant-probe-staging-p2.tsv" | sort | uniq -c
```

Expected: `skipped <n> rows of si_restore (the P1 staging installation's user)`, `every row of <n> is as expected`; the summary shows `ok ok`, `denied denied` and, for `si_member`, `override override` rows, and no `no-login`, `error` or mismatched row. An `ok` row may still fail after its access check passed, and its `code` column shows that error. Any mismatch: stop; the grants, the bundle or the corpus are wrong, and nothing live has changed.

Then the staging installation goes, each block on its own. Deleting it removes its pod; its volumes are kept (`reclaimPolicy: Retain`) until the next block:

si_kubectl get pods -l "clickhouse.altinity.com/chi=$si_p2_staging_chi"

## 4. Engine grants

Before an installation restarts with `table_engines_require_grant`, every user of it that creates tables holds its engines by name (K41): `si_snode` and `si_verifier` exactly `MergeTree` and `ReplicatedMergeTree`, `si_gateway` the census's set `ENGINE_CENSUS` (`Memory`, `MergeTree` and the tenant engines, never a `Replicated*` engine), `si_reader` and `si_backup` none, `default` and `clickhouse_operator` untouched. Each grant is one `GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON <Engine>` appended to that user's `grants/query`; never `ON *` and never a revoke. While the setting is off the grants change nothing, and a users change only reloads, so each installation is one window of its own with the proof that nothing restarted. Order: indexer-b, indexer-c, network (the network installation's reload reaches its source and the three verifier ClickHouses). Each window is three blocks: the baseline (read-only), the commit (local), and one confirmed block that pushes, applies or syncs and then checks, read-only, that the grants arrived and nothing restarted.

### 4.1 indexer-b

Read-only, the baseline:

```bash
hosts='b'
si_chi_state storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b | tee "$si_backup/chi-indexer-b-engines-before.txt"
for h in $hosts; do echo "$h $(si_uptime "$h")"; done | tee "$si_backup/uptime-indexer-b-engines-before.txt"
```

si_p2_fresh

python3 -B charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py 2>&1 | tail -3
si_p2_commit "chore(devnet2): P2 engine grants on indexer-b (users reload)" "Stage 3 P2 §4.1 (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md): si_snode and si_gateway of indexer-b's ClickHouse are granted their table engines by name (si_snode MergeTree and ReplicatedMergeTree, si_gateway the engine census) before the restart that turns table_engines_require_grant on. A users reload; nothing restarts. DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES is set from the census." k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source.yaml charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py

  for h in $hosts; do si_p2_wait_grants "$h" engines "$si_backup/grants-$h-base.jsonl"; si_p2_grants "$h" > "$si_backup/grants-$h-engines.jsonl"; done

} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/engines-indexer-b.txt"

## 5. Restart windows

Each SI ClickHouse restarts exactly once, carrying the whole bundle (K39): `zz-si-access-control.xml` (`table_engines_require_grant`), `zz-si-storage.xml` (`keep_free_space_bytes` on every disk, the disk and policy `member`; indexer-c keeps Plan S3-B Task 19's file, which has both already), `zz-si-replicated-merge-tree.xml` (the merge default 0), `zz-si-named-collections.xml` (`NOT OVERRIDABLE` collections) and `zz-pool-settings.xml` (`background_fetches_pool_size` 16), with the reader environment from the reader Secrets, in one commit and one apply, so the operator restarts each pod once. The order is indexer-b, indexer-c, network; never two windows in one session, and a restart never rides with any other change.

A window, as contract §27.5 binds it: the quiet point (`si_quiet_point`), the commit (local), then in one confirmed block the push, the apply and `si_restart_watch` until every pod of the installation restarted once and the CHI is `Completed`; then, read-only, each pod's single restart, `si_p2_stage_check <host> restarted` on every pod, the owner audit's `clickhouse_restart` run (`sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_runs_total{trigger="clickhouse_restart"}` up by one and `unclean_tables` 0); then, confirmed, the 497 probe (as `si_gateway` on the owner's source, a `CREATE TABLE … ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree` refused with 497 naming `TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree`, with no znode under `p2-restart-probe`, the order §3 measured); one acceptance write of that owner that reaches safe; and, read-only, the window's record `restart-<installation>.txt`. During the window the owner's tables answer `SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE` and then Pending (733) until the audit is clean; both are retryable. For the network window also: every block sealed during the window reaches a verdict with quorum, and no track is quarantined.

Then, read-only, the restart's results:

```bash
hosts='b'
{
  awk '/restarts seen:/ && $NF != 1 {bad = 1} /restarts seen:/ {n++} END {exit bad || n == 0}' "$si_backup/restart-indexer-b-watch.txt" || { echo "a pod of indexer-b did not restart exactly once: stop and read §14.3"; exit 1; }
  for h in $hosts; do si_p2_stage_check "$h" restarted; si_p2_grants_check "$h" restarted "$si_backup/grants-$h-engines.jsonl"; si_p2_grants "$h" > "$si_backup/grants-$h-restarted.jsonl"; done
  got="$(si_ch_admin b "SELECT total_space FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'member'")"
  [ "$got" = "$(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-b")" ] || { echo "the member disk of b reads $got, not the $(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-b") §1.2 recorded: stop and ask (§8 uses the recorded total)"; exit 1; }
  echo "member disk of b: $got bytes, as §1.2 recorded"
  base="$(si_series_value 'sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_runs_total{trigger="clickhouse_restart"}' < "$si_backup/audit-b-restart-before.txt")"
  for n in $(seq 1 90); do
    si_audit b > "$si_backup/audit-b-restart-after.txt"
    runs="$(si_series_value 'sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_runs_total{trigger="clickhouse_restart"}' < "$si_backup/audit-b-restart-after.txt")"
    unclean="$(si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables < "$si_backup/audit-b-restart-after.txt")"
    [ "$runs" -gt "$base" ] && [ "$unclean" = 0 ] && break
    sleep 10
  done
  echo "owner $(si_owner_id b): clickhouse_restart audit runs $base -> $runs, unclean_tables $unclean"
  [ "$runs" = $((base + 1)) ] && [ "$unclean" = 0 ] || { echo "the owner audit did not run once clean after the restart: stop (stage-3 P0 runbook §13.3)"; exit 1; }
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/restart-indexer-b-checks.txt"
```

Expected: `stage restarted ok on <host>` and `system.grants is stage restarted's …` on `b`, the member disk's total as §1.2 recorded, `owner 1: clickhouse_restart audit runs <n> -> <n+1>, unclean_tables 0`. Pending (733) answers end with that clean run.

The 497 probe, as `si_gateway` on indexer-b's source (a refused DDL statement; the `{uuid}` path makes even an accepted one fail before it creates anything, §3), then the Keeper read:

Confirm before running.

```bash
{
  [ "$(si_ch_admin b "SELECT count() FROM system.databases WHERE name = 'devnet2'")" = 1 ] || { echo "b has no database devnet2: the probe would answer 81, not 497; stop"; exit 1; }
  out="$(si_ch_exec b si_gateway "CREATE TABLE devnet2.p2_restart_probe (x UInt8) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/p2-restart-probe/{uuid}', 'r') ORDER BY x" 2>&1)" && { echo "the CREATE was accepted: the fence is not on; stop"; si_ch_admin b "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS devnet2.p2_restart_probe SYNC"; exit 1; }
  printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -o 'Code: 497.*TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree' || { echo "not a 497 naming TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree: $out"; exit 1; }
  listing="$(si_keeper "ls '$si_p2_root'")"
  case " $listing " in *" p2-restart-probe "*) echo "the refused CREATE left $si_p2_root/p2-restart-probe: stop and ask"; exit 1 ;; esac
  echo "no znode under $si_p2_root/p2-restart-probe"
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/restart-probe-indexer-b.txt"
```

Expected: `Code: 497. … TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree` and `no znode under /storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2/p2-restart-probe`.

  echo "safe read: 1"

hosts='a v1 v2 v3'
{
  awk '/restarts seen:/ && $NF != 1 {bad = 1} /restarts seen:/ {n++} END {exit bad || n == 0}' "$si_backup/restart-network-watch.txt" || { echo "a pod of network did not restart exactly once: stop and read §14.3"; exit 1; }
  for h in $hosts; do si_p2_stage_check "$h" restarted; si_p2_grants_check "$h" restarted "$si_backup/grants-$h-engines.jsonl"; si_p2_grants "$h" > "$si_backup/grants-$h-restarted.jsonl"; done
  got="$(si_ch_admin a "SELECT total_space FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'member'")"
  [ "$got" = "$(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-a")" ] || { echo "the member disk of a reads $got, not the $(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-a") §1.2 recorded: stop and ask (§8 uses the recorded total)"; exit 1; }
  echo "member disk of a: $got bytes, as §1.2 recorded"
  base="$(si_series_value 'sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_runs_total{trigger="clickhouse_restart"}' < "$si_backup/audit-a-restart-before.txt")"
  for n in $(seq 1 90); do

    runs="$(si_series_value 'sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_runs_total{trigger="clickhouse_restart"}' < "$si_backup/audit-a-restart-after.txt")"
    unclean="$(si_series_value sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables < "$si_backup/audit-a-restart-after.txt")"
    [ "$runs" -gt "$base" ] && [ "$unclean" = 0 ] && break
    sleep 10
  done
  echo "owner $(si_owner_id a): clickhouse_restart audit runs $base -> $runs, unclean_tables $unclean"
  [ "$runs" = $((base + 1)) ] && [ "$unclean" = 0 ] || { echo "the owner audit did not run once clean after the restart: stop (stage-3 P0 runbook §13.3)"; exit 1; }
  first=$(( $(cat "$si_backup/restart-network-sealed-start") + 1 )); last="$(si_p2_sealed)"
  if [ "$last" -ge "$first" ]; then
    si_blockowners "$first" "$last" > "$si_backup/restart-network-blocks.jsonl"
    jq -s -e 'all(.[]; .verdict_evaluated and .quorum)' "$si_backup/restart-network-blocks.jsonl" > /dev/null || { echo "a block sealed during the window has no verdict with quorum: stop (stage-2 runbook §11)"; exit 1; }
    echo "blocks $first to $last sealed during the window: every one evaluated with quorum"
  else
    echo "no block was sealed during the window"
  fi
  ! si_tracks | jq -e '[.indexers[] | select(.quarantined)] | length > 0' > /dev/null || { echo "a track is quarantined: stop"; exit 1; }
  echo "no track is quarantined"
  for v in 0 1 2; do si_metrics "$v" | grep -qxF 'arbiter_nodes{role="verifier",status="active"} 3' || { echo "arbiter-$v does not count three active verifiers: stop"; exit 1; }; done
  echo "every voter counts three active verifiers"
  stage=restarted
  [ "$(si_kubectl get job storage-integrity-si-v2-bootstrap-source -o jsonpath='{.status.succeeded}')" = 1 ] || { echo "the bootstrap-source hook did not succeed: stop and read its log"; exit 1; }
  echo "bootstrap-source hook succeeded"
  si_runtime_uids | diff "$si_backup/runtime-uids-$stage-before.txt" - || { echo "an arbiter or verifier pod was replaced: stop"; exit 1; }
  echo "the arbiter and verifier pods are the same"
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/restart-network-checks.txt"
```

## 6. The unsafe_inc root

Spec §8.2 requires `/sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc` to exist before any member user exists, and devnet2's Keeper shard id is 0 (arbiter-core `dataplane/ddl/naming.go:44-46`), so between the last restart window and the first `si_member` this section creates `/storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2/sentio/0/unsafe_inc`, the network's Keeper root plus `/sentio/0/unsafe_inc`, which every SI installation shares (K42). No reconciler ever creates it and nothing removes it: it stays an empty plain znode until stage 3 P6's `purge` switch scopes new incarnations under it, and an empty znode changes nothing for any existing table. `clickhouse-keeper-client` 26.3 rejects `create '<path>' ''` as a syntax error and exits 0 on every command, so the block creates the node with `touch` (an empty value) and proves it with `ls`; it stops if the node exists without this runbook's record of creating it.

Read-only, first:

```bash
[ -s "$si_backup/p2-restart-end.txt" ] || { echo "the restart windows have not ended (§5.3): stop"; exit 1; }
listing="$(si_keeper "ls '$si_p2_root/sentio/0'")"
case "$listing" in *"No node"*|*rror*) echo "cannot list $si_p2_root/sentio/0: $listing"; exit 1 ;; esac
echo "children of $si_p2_root/sentio/0: $listing"
case " $listing " in
  *" unsafe_inc "*)
    children="$(si_unsafe_inc | tr -d '[:space:]')"
    [ -z "$children" ] || { echo "$si_p2_unsafe_inc exists with children ($children): stop and ask (K42)"; exit 1; }
    grep -q '^created ' "$si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt" 2> /dev/null || { echo "$si_p2_unsafe_inc exists empty without this runbook's record of creating it: stop and ask (K42)"; exit 1; }
    echo "$si_p2_unsafe_inc exists empty after its recorded creation: skip the create, run the record block" ;;
  *) echo "$si_p2_unsafe_inc does not exist yet: the create block may run" ;;
esac
```

Expected: the listing of `/sentio/0` (the `unsafe` path the SNodes' `hg_unsafe` replicas use) without `unsafe_inc`, and `… does not exist yet: the create block may run`.

Confirm before running.

```bash
[ -s "$si_backup/p2-restart-end.txt" ] || { echo "the restart windows have not ended (§5.3): stop"; exit 1; }
[ ! -s "$si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt" ] || { echo "§6 ran already: read $si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt"; exit 1; }
parent="$(si_keeper "ls '$si_p2_root/sentio/0'")"
case "$parent" in *"No node"*|*rror*) echo "cannot list $si_p2_root/sentio/0: $parent"; exit 1 ;; esac
case " $parent " in *" unsafe_inc "*) echo "$si_p2_unsafe_inc exists without this runbook's record of creating it: stop and ask (K42)"; exit 1 ;; esac
si_keeper "touch '$si_p2_unsafe_inc'"
echo "created $si_p2_unsafe_inc $(si_stamp) UTC" | tee "$si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt"
```

Then, read-only (safe to re-run), the proof and the record; its last line is `UNSAFE_INC_ROOT`, which this plan's live task records:

```bash
grep -q '^created ' "$si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt" || { echo "no record of creating unsafe_inc: run the block above"; exit 1; }
listing="$(si_keeper "ls '$si_p2_root/sentio/0'")"
case " $listing " in *" unsafe_inc "*) ;; *) echo "$si_p2_unsafe_inc does not exist ($listing): stop"; exit 1 ;; esac
children="$(si_unsafe_inc | tr -d '[:space:]')"
[ -z "$children" ] || { echo "$si_p2_unsafe_inc has children ($children): stop and ask (K42)"; exit 1; }
grep -qxF "UNSAFE_INC_ROOT=$si_p2_unsafe_inc" "$si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt" || {
  echo "children of $si_p2_root/sentio/0: $listing"
  echo "unsafe_inc is an empty plain znode"
  echo "UNSAFE_INC_ROOT=$si_p2_unsafe_inc"
} >> "$si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt"
cat "$si_backup/unsafe-inc.txt"
```

Expected: `created …`, the listing with `unsafe` (the legacy path the SNodes' `hg_unsafe` replicas use) and `unsafe_inc`, `unsafe_inc is an empty plain znode`, and the last line `UNSAFE_INC_ROOT=/storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2/sentio/0/unsafe_inc`.

## 7. Member users

`si_member` (spec §8.2 as amended, decision D36) exists on an installation only from its `member` stage, after its restart (§5) and after `UNSAFE_INC_ROOT` (§6): exactly the sixteen grants of `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS` (Plan S3-C2 contract §23.2) with one `GRANT NAMED COLLECTION ON <collection>` per collection of that installation before `GRANT READ ON REMOTE`, its literal SHA-256 hash, `networks/ip` `::/0` and the profile `si_member` (`max_memory_usage` 4 GiB, `max_concurrent_queries_for_user` 8, `max_threads` 4, `priority` 10). Its `hg_rstage` right names `SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE` and is never `ALL`. `si_member_ddl` is not created anywhere before stage 3 P6 step 6. A users reload: each installation is its own window with the proof that nothing restarted, in the order indexer-b, indexer-c, network; then §7.4 probes every SI ClickHouse as `si_member`.

  while read -r h up; do now="$(si_uptime "$h")"; [ "$now" -gt "$up" ] || { echo "$h: uptime fell to $now: ClickHouse restarted; stop"; exit 1; }; done < "$si_backup/uptime-indexer-c-member-before.txt"
  for h in $hosts; do si_p2_stage_check "$h" member; done

### 7.4 Member probe

Every SI ClickHouse, as `si_member`, against the live collections of its installation: the refusal-only corpus `charts/storage-integrity/tests/si_member_live_probe.tsv` (the sixteen `Replicated*MergeTree` rows, the eight reaching-engine rows, the `Replicated` database row, the table-free `hg_rstage` creation rows, `INSERT INTO FUNCTION remote(si_owner_<id>, …)` and the four overrides), every row `denied` (497) or `override` (36), and each refused `CREATE TABLE … ENGINE = <X>` naming `TABLE ENGINE ON <X>`. No si-member runs yet, so the probe creates `hg_rstage` and `hg_replica` as `si_member` and drops them again on each host. The statements are refused, but they are DDL and an `INSERT` on live hosts, so each installation's probe is a confirmed block of its own (indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network installation's four ClickHouses):

Confirm before running.

```bash
si_member_probe b 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/member-probe-indexer-b.txt"
```

Confirm before running.

```bash
si_member_probe c 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/member-probe-indexer-c.txt"
```

Confirm before running.

```bash
for h in a v1 v2 v3; do si_member_probe "$h"; done 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/member-probe-network.txt"
```

Expected: `member probe ok on <host> (<n> rows)` for `b`, `c`, `a`, `v1`, `v2` and `v3`, the same `<n>` six times, and `$si_backup/member-probe-<host>.tsv` with every row's `got` equal to its `expect`. A row that was accepted (its object is dropped again by the helper) or answered otherwise: stop; the users or the bundle of that installation are wrong, and §13 reverts its `member` stage.

## 8. si-members

One si-member per SI indexer host, each in its own StatefulSet `<release>-si-member` of the host's sentio-node release (never in the host pod): its own ConfigMap `<release>-si-member-config` and pod annotation `checksum/si-member-config`, its own state volume (`/data/si-member`), the digest-pinned member image, the `si_member` password from `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>` and the restore key of stage 3 P1 in the `si-member` container only, the status token from its own Secret, metrics on 9095 and the reserved status port 9096 on Service `<release>-si-member`, and the reconciler slot off. Its config names the host's own source ClickHouse, every other SI indexer as a peer through its `si_owner_<id>` collection, the pool verifiers' collections, the P1 bucket as restore source, `shadow_verification: true`, `storage_policy: member`, `stop_installs_ratio` 0.5 and `disk_budget_bytes` = the member disk's total of §1.2, so installs pause at half the member disk (decision D28, K40). Off consensus: a member reads the watermark, manifests, block verifications, the registry and DA payloads, and writes only its own `hg_replica` and `hg_rstage` tables on the member disk.

Order: `member-b` (indexer-b), `member-c` (indexer-c), `member-a` (indexer-a); one member per window, each a single-service commit of its host overlay with `DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED` and a sync of that release only. Starting a member changes nothing in the host pod: the render diff names only the three member objects, and the host pod's uid and restart count and the host StatefulSet's generation and revision stay the same.

### 8.1 member-b

Read-only, the baseline:

```bash
{
  [ -s "$si_backup/member-probe-b.tsv" ] || { echo "§7.4 has not probed b: stop"; exit 1; }
  [ -z "$(si_kubectl get pod "$(si_member_pod b)" --ignore-not-found -o name)" ] || { echo "member-b runs already"; exit 1; }
  si_p2_host_state b
  si_p2_host_sts b
  live="$(si_ch_admin b "SELECT total_space FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'member'")"
  metric="$(si_ch_admin b "SELECT toUInt64(value) FROM system.asynchronous_metrics WHERE metric = 'DiskTotal_member'")"
  [ "$live" = "$(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-b")" ] && [ "$metric" = "$live" ] || { echo "the member disk of b reads total_space $live, DiskTotal_member $metric, not the $(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-b") of §1.2: stop and ask"; exit 1; }
  echo "disk_budget_bytes $(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-b") (DiskTotal_member of the member disk, decision D28)"
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/host-b-before-member.txt"
```

Then, read-only, the member's start and the untouched host:

```bash
{
  pod="$(si_member_pod b)"
  for n in $(seq 1 60); do [ "$(si_kubectl get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.status.containerStatuses[?(@.name=="si-member")].started}' 2> /dev/null)" = true ] && break; sleep 10; done
  si_kubectl get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name} node={.spec.nodeName} image={.spec.containers[?(@.name=="si-member")].image} restarts={.status.containerStatuses[?(@.name=="si-member")].restartCount}{"\n"}'
  [ "$(si_kubectl get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.spec.containers[?(@.name=="si-member")].image}')" = "$(si_p2_image)" ] || { echo "member-b does not run the member image: stop"; exit 1; }
  si_kubectl logs "$pod" -c si-member | head -n 40
  sleep 60
  si_member_metrics b 'sentio_node_si_member_(info|ready|copies|installs_total|installs_paused|disk_budget_bytes|disk_used_bytes|grants_unreadable|unconfigured_owners|audit_clean|shadow_next_block_seq)'
  [ "$(si_member_metrics b sentio_node_si_member_disk_budget_bytes | awk '{printf "%.0f\n", $2}')" = "$(cat "$si_backup/member-disk-b")" ] || { echo "member-b's disk budget is not the recorded member disk total: stop"; exit 1; }
  si_member_metrics b sentio_node_si_member_unconfigured_owners | grep -q ' 0$' || { echo "member-b lists an enrolled owner it does not copy: stop"; exit 1; }
  si_member_metrics b sentio_node_si_member_grants_unreadable | grep -q ' 0$' || { echo "member-b cannot read its own grants: stop"; exit 1; }
  si_p2_host_unchanged b
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/bootstrap-member-b.txt"
echo "member-b started; the host is untouched"
```

Expected: `member-b`'s pod on the member image with `restarts=0`; its first log lines (the startup steps of Plan S3-C2 contract §23.1: the state-dir lock, the member databases without `ENGINE`, the engine fence and the read-only remote checks passing, the startup audit, then the copyset and the feed); `sentio_node_si_member_info{node_id="member-b",…} 1`, `disk_budget_bytes` the recorded total, `unconfigured_owners 0`, `grants_unreadable 0`, `installs_paused 0`; `host sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-<x> unchanged since member-<x> started (<time>)` (the host pod and its containers started before the member's StatefulSet existed, none restarted since, the pod on its StatefulSet's current and update revision, and its uid, restart count, generation and revisions equal to the baseline); `member-b started; the host is untouched`. A refusal at startup (the engine fence, a writable remote, a node id in use, an unenrolled peer, the genesis check) ends the process: read its log, turn the member off (§13) and stop. A host that changed: turn the member off (§13) at once and stop.

A host that changed: turn the member off (§13) at once and stop.

That renders the VMServiceScrape `storage-integrity-si-v2-members` (port `metrics` of the `si-member` Services, relabelled `network`, `si_component=member`, `release` and `member`) and the rule group `storage-integrity-si-v2.members`: `StorageIntegrityMemberUnscraped` (10m), `StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch` (critical, at once), `StorageIntegrityMemberForeignPart` (critical, at once), `StorageIntegrityMemberDiverged`, `StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind` (30m) and `StorageIntegrityMemberDiskHigh` (member disk above 50 %, 15m), each with its `runbook_url` into this file.

## 9. Bootstrap

Each member starts with no copy and installs every Active table of both peer owners up to their latest published entry: from the P1 backups by restore for the bulk (spec §8.6; P1's backups are the bootstrap source) and by owner pull for the rest, every part checked by the install gate. Read-only, re-runnable; it waits up to six hours and records each member's state:

```bash
{
  for n in $(seq 1 360); do
    if si_copies_check > "$si_backup/copies-bootstrap.jsonl" 2> /dev/null; then break; fi
    sleep 60
  done
  cat "$si_backup/copies-bootstrap.jsonl"
  for x in b c a; do
    echo "member-$x:"
    si_member_metrics "$x" 'sentio_node_si_member_(ready|copies|installs_total|install_outcomes_total|foreign_tables|diverged_partitions_total|diverged_tables|installs_paused|disk_used_bytes|disk_budget_bytes|audit_clean)'
  done
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/bootstrap.txt"
tail -n 1 "$si_backup/copies-bootstrap.jsonl" | grep -qx 'copies equal: 6 of 6' || { echo "the copies did not reach the published entries within six hours: read bootstrap.txt (§14.1)"; exit 1; }
python3 -I - "$si_backup/bootstrap.txt" <<'EOF'
import re, sys
text = open(sys.argv[1]).read()
def total(pattern):
    return sum(float(v) for v in re.findall(pattern + r"(?:\{[^}]*\})? ([0-9.e+]+)$", text, re.M))
def each(name):
    return [float(v) for v in re.findall("^" + name + r"(?:\{[^}]*\})? ([0-9.e+]+)$", text, re.M)]
restore = total(r'^sentio_node_si_member_installs_total\{source="restore"\}')
pull = total(r'^sentio_node_si_member_installs_total\{source="owner_pull"\}')
problems = []
if restore <= 0:
    problems.append("no member installed from the P1 backups (installs_total{source=\"restore\"} is 0 on all three)")
if pull <= 0:
    problems.append("no member installed by owner pull")
for name in ("sentio_node_si_member_foreign_tables", "sentio_node_si_member_diverged_partitions_total", "sentio_node_si_member_diverged_tables", "sentio_node_si_member_installs_paused"):
    if any(v != 0 for v in each(name)):
        problems.append(f"{name} is not 0 everywhere")
if each("sentio_node_si_member_ready") != [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] or each("sentio_node_si_member_audit_clean") != [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]:
    problems.append("a member is not ready with a clean audit")
for p in problems:
    print("FAIL:", p)
if problems:
    sys.exit(1)
print(f"bootstrap ok: installs from restore {restore:.0f}, by owner pull {pull:.0f}; no foreign or diverged copy; every member ready")
EOF
```

Expected: six JSON lines with `"equal": true` and `copies equal: 6 of 6`, then `bootstrap ok: installs from restore <n>, by owner pull <m>; no foreign or diverged copy; every member ready`. A Foreign or Diverged copy, paused installs or a missing restore: stop and follow §14.1.

## 10. Shadow soak

Spec §16 row P2 as amended (K38): on devnet2 every member shadow-verifies every block of its two peer owners sealed during a soak of at least 24 hours, with zero mismatches; the soak's writes spend at most half the promotion budget (§1.3); missed scans (a candidate part the owner cleaned before the member pulled it into `hg_rstage`) are counted apart and reported, and every owner has at least one block per write round that every member shadowed without a missed scan, so the byte scans ran; the copies stay at the latest published entry; the member disks stay below 50 %. The 500-blocks-per-owner volume and the Rejected-statement test are Plan S3-C2 Task 36's release-path full soak (`P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK`, §1.1 and §1.3), never re-run on devnet2: the consensus state grows about quadratically in promotions, so devnet2 cannot carry 500 blocks per owner.

The soak is: the start (read-only); round 1 at once, round 2 at least 12 hours and round 3 at least 24 hours after the start, each a read-only pre-round sample, one confirmed block of `k` writes per owner (owner 0 through indexer-a's sidecar, owners 1 and `INDEXER_C_ID` through the `devuser1` owner's agent in the user's own terminal, as in §1.3) and the read-only round check; sampling at any time; the end at least 24 hours after the start and after round 3's writes. Round `r` writes indexer-a's values `5202 + (r - 1)·k` to `5201 + r·k` and rows `2 + (r - 1)·k` to `1 + r·k` of both soak tables (`v` = `p2-10-<id>`); every owner's block appends to `soak-writes-<r>.txt` and leaves the marker `soak-writes-<r>-<owner>.done`, so a write never runs twice. Nothing else changes on devnet2-si-v2 during the soak: no sync, apply or pod deletion, no table-set transition (the shadow verifier skips those) and no other write drill (its promotions would count against this budget).

The start, read-only (it writes only local records; a second run prints the record and stops there). It computes `k` from `budget-start.txt` as §1.3 did, checks that the soak's `9k` writes still fit in half the budget after every promotion since §1.3, waits until every member's shadow verifier has passed the sealed tip, and records the start in `soak-start` and `soak-k`:

```bash
if [ -s "$si_backup/soak-start" ]; then echo "the soak started already:"; cat "$si_backup/soak-start"; exit 0; fi
grep -qx 'copies equal: 6 of 6' "$si_backup/copies-bootstrap.jsonl" || { echo "bootstrap has not finished (§9): stop"; exit 1; }
[ -s "$si_backup/p2-monitoring-commit" ] || { echo "the members are not monitored (§8.4): stop"; exit 1; }
line="$(tail -n 1 "$si_backup/budget-start.txt")"
B="$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | sed -n 's/.*budget to L\/4 ([0-9]* bytes): \([0-9][0-9]*\) promotions;.*/\1/p')"
L0="$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | sed -n 's/.*; live promotion \([0-9][0-9]*\);.*/\1/p')"
[ -n "$B" ] && [ -n "$L0" ] || { echo "budget-start.txt holds no estimator line (§1.3): stop"; exit 1; }
K=$(( (B / 2 - 3) / 9 ))
[ "$K" -le 3 ] || K=3
[ "$K" -ge 1 ] || { echo "a budget of $B promotions leaves no soak write (k=$K): stop (contract §27.7)"; exit 1; }
spent=$(( $(si_show | jq -r .promotion_seq) - L0 ))
[ $((spent + 9 * K)) -le $((B / 2)) ] || { echo "$spent promotions since §1.3 and $((9 * K)) soak writes exceed half the budget ($((B / 2))): stop (contract §27.7)"; exit 1; }
echo "budget room ok: spent $spent since the start, $((9 * K)) planned, half the budget $((B / 2))"
sealed="$(si_p2_sealed)"
for n in $(seq 1 90); do
  si_shadow_sample > "$si_backup/soak-start-sample.tsv"
  awk -F'\t' -v l="$sealed" '$11 <= l {behind = 1} END {exit behind}' "$si_backup/soak-start-sample.tsv" && break
  sleep 20
done
awk -F'\t' -v l="$sealed" '$11 <= l {behind = 1} END {exit behind}' "$si_backup/soak-start-sample.tsv" || { echo "a member's shadow verifier is not past the sealed tip $sealed after 30 minutes: stop (§14.1)"; exit 1; }
[ "$(si_p2_sealed)" = "$sealed" ] || { echo "a block was sealed while the start was sampled: run this block again"; exit 1; }
awk -F'\t' '$5 != 0 {bad = 1} END {exit bad}' "$si_backup/soak-start-sample.tsv" || { echo "a member counts shadow mismatches already: stop (§14.1)"; exit 1; }
version="$(si_status a devnet101 swap_new2 | jq -r .registry_version)"
[[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "no registry version from indexer-a: stop"; exit 1; }
cat "$si_backup/soak-start-sample.tsv" >> "$si_backup/soak.tsv"
printf 'SOAK_START_UTC=%s\nSOAK_START_SEALED=%s\nSOAK_START_REGISTRY_VERSION=%s\nSOAK_K=%s\nSOAK_B=%s\nSOAK_L0=%s\n' "$(cut -f1 "$si_backup/soak-start-sample.tsv" | head -n 1)" "$sealed" "$version" "$K" "$B" "$L0" > "$si_backup/soak-start"
printf '%s\n' "$K" > "$si_backup/soak-k"
cat "$si_backup/soak-start-sample.tsv" "$si_backup/soak-start"
```

Expected: `budget room ok: …`; six sample lines (`member-b` with owners 0 and `INDEXER_C_ID`, `member-c` with 0 and 1, `member-a` with 1 and `INDEXER_C_ID`), each with 0 mismatches, `behind_seconds` 0 and the shadow's next block above the sealed tip; and the six lines of `soak-start`.

Each round `r` (1, 2, 3) is five blocks; set `r` in each. First the pre-round checks and sample, read-only (a second run prints the sample taken):

```bash
r=1
case "$r" in 1|2|3) ;; *) echo "r is 1, 2 or 3"; exit 1 ;; esac
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$si_backup/soak-start"
need=$(( (r - 1) * 43200 ))
elapsed=$(( $(date -u +%s) - $(si_epoch "$SOAK_START_UTC") ))
[ "$elapsed" -ge "$need" ] || { echo "round $r starts no earlier than $((need / 3600)) h after the soak start: $(( (need - elapsed) / 60 )) minutes to go"; exit 1; }
[ "$r" = 1 ] || grep -q '^round ok' "$si_backup/soak-round-$((r - 1)).txt" 2> /dev/null || { echo "round $((r - 1)) has not passed its check: stop"; exit 1; }
spent=$(( $(si_show | jq -r .promotion_seq) - SOAK_L0 ))
[ $((spent + 3 * SOAK_K * (4 - r))) -le $((SOAK_B / 2)) ] || { echo "$spent promotions since §1.3 and $((3 * SOAK_K * (4 - r))) writes still to come exceed half the budget ($((SOAK_B / 2))): stop"; exit 1; }
[ "$(si_status a devnet101 swap_new2 | jq -r .registry_version)" = "$SOAK_START_REGISTRY_VERSION" ] || { echo "the table registry moved since the soak start (a table-set transition inside the soak): stop and report"; exit 1; }
if [ -s "$si_backup/soak-round-$r-before.tsv" ]; then echo "round $r's pre-round sample was taken already:"; cat "$si_backup/soak-round-$r-before.tsv"; exit 0; fi
si_shadow_sample > "$si_backup/soak-round-$r-before.tsv"
cat "$si_backup/soak-round-$r-before.tsv" >> "$si_backup/soak.tsv"
cat "$si_backup/soak-round-$r-before.tsv"
echo "round $r ready: indexer-a values $((5202 + (r - 1) * SOAK_K)) to $((5201 + r * SOAK_K)), rows $((2 + (r - 1) * SOAK_K)) to $((1 + r * SOAK_K)) of both soak tables"
```

A mismatch fires `StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch` as well: P2 stops; follow §14.1. A round in which a member shadowed no block of a peer owner without a missed scan (every candidate part cleaned before its pull) is reported; the user decides whether one more write of that owner fits the budget (a confirmed block of its own), never by writes beyond half the budget.

Sampling, read-only, at any time (a few times a day):

```bash
si_shadow_sample | tee -a "$si_backup/soak.tsv"
si_copies_check | tail -n 1
si_vm_query 'ALERTS{alertstate="firing",alertname=~"StorageIntegrityMember.*"}' | jq -c '[.data.result[].metric]'
```

Expected: mismatches never grow, `behind_seconds` back at 0 after each publication, `copies equal: 6 of 6` between writes, and `[]`.

The end, read-only, at least 24 hours after the start and after round 3's writes (a second run prints the record):

```bash
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$si_backup/soak-start"
if [ -s "$si_backup/soak-end" ]; then echo "the soak ended already:"; cat "$si_backup/soak-end"; exit 0; fi
[ $(( $(date -u +%s) - $(si_epoch "$SOAK_START_UTC") )) -ge 86400 ] || { echo "the soak has not lasted 24 hours yet"; exit 1; }
for o in a b c; do [ -e "$si_backup/soak-writes-3-$o.done" ] || { echo "owner $o's writes of round 3 have not run: stop"; exit 1; }; done
[ "$(si_status a devnet101 swap_new2 | jq -r .registry_version)" = "$SOAK_START_REGISTRY_VERSION" ] || { echo "the table registry moved during the soak: stop and report"; exit 1; }
last="$(si_p2_sealed)"
for n in $(seq 1 90); do
  si_shadow_sample > "$si_backup/soak-end-sample.tsv"
  awk -F'\t' -v l="$last" '$11 <= l {behind = 1} END {exit behind}' "$si_backup/soak-end-sample.tsv" && break
  sleep 20
done
awk -F'\t' -v l="$last" '$11 <= l {behind = 1} END {exit behind}' "$si_backup/soak-end-sample.tsv" || { echo "a member's shadow verifier is not past the sealed tip $last after 30 minutes: stop (§14.1)"; exit 1; }
cat "$si_backup/soak-end-sample.tsv" >> "$si_backup/soak.tsv"
printf 'SOAK_END_UTC=%s\nSOAK_END_SEALED=%s\n' "$(cut -f1 "$si_backup/soak-end-sample.tsv" | head -n 1)" "$last" > "$si_backup/soak-end"
cat "$si_backup/soak-end"
```

Expected: `SOAK_END_UTC=<time>` and `SOAK_END_SEALED=<block>`.

## 11. Measurements

Read-only. The soak's verdict (every sealed non-transition block of each peer owner shadowed by each member, every soak block evaluated with quorum, zero mismatches, the member disks below 50 %), the copies, the alert history and the members' cost to their hosts (spec §18: members compete with the SNode for CPU, memory and fetch threads):

```bash
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$si_backup/soak-start"
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$si_backup/soak-end"
hours=$(( ($(si_epoch "$SOAK_END_UTC") - $(si_epoch "$SOAK_START_UTC")) / 3600 + 1 ))
{
  si_blockowners "$((SOAK_START_SEALED + 1))" "$SOAK_END_SEALED" > "$si_backup/blocks-soak.jsonl"
  echo "blocks $((SOAK_START_SEALED + 1)) to $SOAK_END_SEALED: $(wc -l < "$si_backup/blocks-soak.jsonl" | tr -d ' ') sealed, per owner (non-transition): $(jq -s -c 'map(select(.transition | not)) | group_by(.owner) | map({owner: .[0].owner, blocks: length})' "$si_backup/blocks-soak.jsonl")"
  si_copies_check | tee "$si_backup/copies.jsonl"
  echo "StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind fired in the last 24 h: $(si_vm_query 'count_over_time(ALERTS{alertname="StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind",alertstate="firing"}[24h])' | jq -c '[.data.result[].metric]')"
  echo "StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch fired in the soak: $(si_vm_query "count_over_time(ALERTS{alertname=\"StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch\",alertstate=\"firing\"}[${hours}h])" | jq -c '[.data.result[].metric]')"
  echo "copy lag series over the last 24 h: $(si_vm_query 'count(max_over_time(sentio_node_si_member_copy_behind_seconds{network="devnet2-si-v2"}[24h]))' | jq -r '.data.result[0].value[1] // "0"')"
  for x in a b c; do
    if [ "$x" = c ]; then path=/var/lib/clickhouse-member; else path=/var/lib/clickhouse; fi
    df_line="$(si_kubectl exec "$(si_ch_pod "$x")" -c clickhouse -- df -B1 --output=size,avail "$path" | tail -n 1)"
    echo "member-$x disk: $path filesystem size, available: $df_line; used $(echo "$df_line" | awk '{printf "%.4f", ($1 - $2) / $1}')"
    echo "member-$x bytes on disk member: parts $(si_ch_admin "$x" "SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) FROM system.parts WHERE disk_name = 'member'"), detached $(si_ch_admin "$x" "SELECT sum(bytes_on_disk) FROM system.detached_parts WHERE disk = 'member'")"
  done
  for x in a b c; do si_kubectl get pod "$(si_member_pod "$x")" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name} phase={.status.phase} restarts={.status.containerStatuses[?(@.name=="si-member")].restartCount}{"\n"}'; done
  si_vm_query "max by (pod) (max_over_time(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=\"sentio-network-devnet2\",container=~\"si-member|sentio-node\",pod=~\"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-.*\"}[${hours}h]))" | jq -c '[.data.result[] | {pod: .metric.pod, max_working_set_bytes: .value[1]}]'
  si_vm_query "max by (pod) (max_over_time(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=\"sentio-network-devnet2\",container=~\"si-member|sentio-node\",pod=~\"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-.*\"}[5m])[${hours}h:5m]))" | jq -c '[.data.result[] | {pod: .metric.pod, max_cores: .value[1]}]'
  si_vm_query "max by (pod) (max_over_time(ClickHouseMetrics_BackgroundFetchesPoolTask{namespace=\"sentio-network-devnet2\"}[${hours}h]))" | jq -c '[.data.result[] | {pod: .metric.pod, max_fetch_tasks: .value[1]}]'
  si_p2_py soak "$si_backup"
} 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/measurements.txt"
! grep -q '^FAIL' "$si_backup/measurements.txt" || { echo "a soak criterion failed: stop (read measurements.txt)"; exit 1; }
grep -qx 'copies equal: 6 of 6' "$si_backup/copies.jsonl" || { echo "the copies are not at the latest published entries: stop"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind fired in the last 24 h: \[\]$' "$si_backup/measurements.txt" || { echo "StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind fired within the last 24 hours of the soak: stop"; exit 1; }
grep -q 'StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch fired in the soak: \[\]$' "$si_backup/measurements.txt" || { echo "StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch fired: stop"; exit 1; }
grep -qx 'copy lag series over the last 24 h: 6' "$si_backup/measurements.txt" || { echo "the copy lag series do not cover the six member and owner pairs, so the alert could not have fired: stop"; exit 1; }
awk '/^member-. disk:/ {if ($NF + 0 >= 0.5) bad = 1} END {exit bad}' "$si_backup/measurements.txt" || { echo "a member disk's filesystem is 50 % used or more: stop"; exit 1; }
[ "$(grep -cE '^sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-[abc]-si-member-0 phase=Running restarts=0$' "$si_backup/measurements.txt")" = 3 ] || { echo "a member pod restarted during the soak (its counters were reset): stop and report"; exit 1; }
echo "measurements ok"
```

Expected: the soak's blocks per owner; `copies equal: 6 of 6`; `[]` for both alert histories and `copy lag series over the last 24 h: 6` (the positive control that the alert's input existed throughout); each member disk's filesystem below `0.5000` used, with the member bytes; the three member pods Running without a restart; the members' and the hosts' peak memory, CPU and fetch tasks for the record; then the soak verdict's six lines `<member> owner <id>: shadowed +<n> of <m> sealed non-transition blocks, +0 mismatches, …`, its window line, `soak ok: …` and `measurements ok`. A block of a peer owner that a member did not shadow, a block without a verdict with quorum or a mismatch fails the verdict: stop and report.
````
