`t41-helpers.py`, the session-helpers extractor (the parsing code of Plan S3-B Tasks 15, 18, 21 and of Task 40), with which Step 1 checks that `helpers.sh` still holds the runbooks of `origin/main`:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Print the session helpers of the P2 members runbook, earlier runbooks first (Plan S3-C3 Task 41).

  t41-helpers.py DOCS_DIR RUNBOOK.md

Task 41 compares this output with the start of Task 40's helpers.sh, to know
that the session still defines the helpers of the runbooks on origin/main. A
runbook's "## 0. Session helpers" section names the earlier runbooks whose §0
helpers it builds on (Markdown links before its first bash block) and then
holds its own helpers in its first bash block (decision D20). This prints,
depth first and each runbook once, the earlier runbooks' first §0 bash blocks
and then the runbook's own, each behind a comment naming its source. Blocks
are found by their fences, line by line (decision D24): a fence opens on a
line of three or more backquotes and closes only on a line of at least as
many backquotes and nothing else. This is the parsing code of Plan S3-B Tasks
15, 18 and 21 and of Plan S3-C3 Task 40, with its messages renamed.
"""

import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

FENCE = re.compile(r"(`{3,})([^`\s]*)\s*$")


def section_zero(path):
    lines = path.read_text().split("\n")
    if "## 0. Session helpers" not in lines:
        sys.exit(f"t41-helpers: {path} has no '## 0. Session helpers' section")
    intro, block, fence = [], None, None
    for line in lines[lines.index("## 0. Session helpers") + 1:]:
        if fence is None:
            opening = FENCE.match(line)
            if opening:
                fence = opening.group(1)
                if opening.group(2) == "bash":
                    block = []
            elif line.startswith("## "):
                break
            else:
                intro.append(line)
        elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
            if block is not None:
                earlier = re.findall(r"\]\((storage-integrity-devnet2-[a-z0-9-]+\.md)\)", "\n".join(intro))
                return earlier, "\n".join(block) + "\n"
            fence = None
        elif block is not None:
            block.append(line)
    sys.exit(f"t41-helpers: {path}: no complete bash block in section 0")


def collect(docs, name, seen, out):
    if name in seen:
        return
    seen.add(name)
    earlier, block = section_zero(docs / name)
    for other in earlier:
        collect(docs, other, seen, out)
    out.append((name, block))


def main(docs, runbook):
    out = []
    collect(Path(docs), runbook, set(), out)
    for name, block in out:
        print(f"# --- §0 of docs/{name}")
        print(block, end="" if block.endswith("\n") else "\n")
    print("# --- end of runbook helpers: " + " ".join(name for name, _ in out), file=sys.stderr)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 3:
        sys.exit(__doc__)
    main(*sys.argv[1:])
```

`t41-check.py`, this task's independent checks:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The independent read-only checks of Plan S3-C3 Task 41 (a throwaway tool, never committed).

  t41-check.py state PHASE SI_BACKUP INDEXER_C_ID ENGINE_CENSUS MEMBER_IMAGE
  t41-check.py commit member|monitoring X SI_BACKUP INDEXER_C_ID
  t41-check.py render X RENDER_FILE SI_BACKUP INDEXER_C_ID MEMBER_IMAGE
  t41-check.py member-pod X POD_LINE INDEXER_C_ID MEMBER_IMAGE
  t41-check.py room BUDGET_START_FILE LIVE_PROMOTION_SEQ PLANNED_WRITES

Run from the root of the live production checkout. X is a member host: a
(member-a on indexer-a, SI indexer 0), b (member-b on indexer-b, 1) or c
(member-c on indexer-c, INDEXER_C_ID); for monitoring X is "-". The member
disk total of host X is $SI_BACKUP/member-disk-X (runbook §1.2), each member's
disk_budget_bytes (decision D28).

state checks test_render.py's rollout constants and every siMember and
monitoring.members value against contract §26.4-§26.7, rebuilt here from the
contract and the ledger rather than read from the runbook's helpers; PHASE is
none, b, bc, bca (the members started so far, in the order b, c, a) or
monitored (all three and the monitoring commit). commit checks that HEAD is
exactly that commit of contract §28.2 on top of HEAD~1: the two files, the
lines that change (comments and layout kept), the values, the subject and the
trailer. render checks a helmfile rendering of X's host release at HEAD
(contract §26.2, §26.3, decision D29). member-pod checks one JSON line of the
running si-member pod (names and Secret references only, never a value).
room refuses unless the promotions made since budget-start.txt plus the
planned writes stay within half of its budget (contract §27.7). Every check
prints what it compared and ends with one "ok" line, or exits non-zero with a
line ending "stop".
"""

import ast
import difflib
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

TESTS = "charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py"
D2 = "k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2"
SI_OVERLAY = f"{D2}/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
ORDER = ("b", "c", "a")
RELEASES = ("sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b", "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c")
CHIS = ("storage-integrity-si-v2", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c")
POOL = ["si_peer_verifier_1", "si_peer_verifier_2", "si_peer_verifier_3"]
RESTORE = {"endpoint": "https://storage.googleapis.com", "bucket": "sentio-352722-si-devnet2-si-v2-replica"}
TRAILER = "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
MEMBER_KEYS = {
    "node_id", "host_indexer_id", "state_dir", "network_id", "genesis_snapshot_id", "genesis_tables", "clickhouse_dsn",
    "clickhouse_username", "storage_policy", "peers", "pool_collections", "restore", "shadow_verification",
    "stop_installs_ratio", "disk_budget_bytes", "metrics_listen",
}
SECRETISH = re.compile(r"(?i)password|token|secret|key$")
BUDGET = re.compile(r"live promotion ([0-9]+); budget to L/4 \(([0-9]+) bytes\): ([0-9]+) promotions; a drill spends at most ([0-9]+)$")


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"t41-check: {message}; stop")


def host(x, c):
    c = int(c)
    if c in (0, 1):
        fail(f"INDEXER_C_ID {c} is the id of indexer-a or indexer-b")
    table = {
        "a": (0, "storage-integrity-si-v2-source:9000", "network", "§8.3"),
        "b": (1, "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source:9000", "indexer-b", "§8.1"),
        "c": (c, "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-source:9000", "indexer-c", "§8.2"),
    }
    if x not in table:
        fail(f"unknown member host {x!r} (a, b or c)")
    indexer, dsn, installation, section = table[x]
    release = f"sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-{x}"
    return {
        "x": x,
        "release": release,
        "member": f"member-{x}",
        "indexer": indexer,
        "dsn": dsn,
        "installation": installation,
        "section": section,
        "secret": f"storage-integrity-si-v2-member-{installation}",
        "token": f"{release}-si-member-status-token",
        "restore": f"storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-{x}",
        "overlay": f"{D2}/sentio-node-indexer-{x}-storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml",
        "peers": [{"indexer_id": i, "collection": f"si_owner_{i}"} for i in sorted({0, 1, c}) if i != indexer],
        "subject": f"chore(devnet2): start si-member member-{x} on {release}",
    }


def disk_of(si_backup, x):
    text = Path(si_backup, f"member-disk-{x}").read_text().strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", text):
        fail(f"{si_backup}/member-disk-{x} holds {text!r}, not the member disk's total (runbook §1.2)")
    return int(text)


def assignments(source, where):
    out = {}
    for node in ast.parse(source).body:
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            if node.targets[0].id in out:
                fail(f"{where} assigns {node.targets[0].id} more than once")
            out[node.targets[0].id] = node
    return out


def literal(source, name, where):
    node = assignments(source, where).get(name)
    if node is None:
        fail(f"{where} has no module-level {name}")
    try:
        return ast.literal_eval(node.value)
    except ValueError:
        fail(f"{where}: {name} is not a literal")


def constants(source, where):
    """The rollout constants of test_render.py that Task 41 reads, from their literals."""
    image = literal(source, "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE", where)
    images = assignments(source, where).get("MEMBER_IMAGES")
    if images is None or ast.unparse(images.value) != "frozenset({DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE})":
        fail(f"{where}: MEMBER_IMAGES is not frozenset({{DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE}})")
    names = ("DEVNET2_P2_STAGE", "DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES", "DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS", "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS",
             "DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED", "DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS", "DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS")
    out = {name: literal(source, name, where) for name in names}
    out["DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE"] = image
    return out


def started(phase):
    if phase not in ("none", "b", "bc", "bca", "monitored"):
        fail(f"PHASE {phase!r} is none, b, bc, bca or monitored")
    return {"none": "", "b": "b", "bc": "bc", "bca": "bca", "monitored": "bca"}[phase]


def expect_member(doc, h, enabled, budget, image, where):
    """Contract §26.5's siMember block of one host overlay, rebuilt from the contract."""
    m = doc.get("siMember")
    if not isinstance(m, dict):
        fail(f"{where} has no siMember block (P2_PR, Task 38)")
    cfg = m.get("config") or {}
    snode = ((doc.get("storageIntegrity") or {}).get("snode")) or {}
    want = {
        "enabled": enabled,
        "image": image,
        "nodeID": h["member"],
        "clickhouseDSN": h["dsn"],
        "secret.name": h["secret"],
        "statusTokenSecret.name": h["token"],
        "restoreSecret.name": h["restore"],
        "reconciler.enabled": False,
        "config.host_indexer_id": h["indexer"],
        "config.genesis_snapshot_id": snode.get("genesisSnapshotID"),
        "config.storage_policy": "member",
        "config.peers": h["peers"],
        "config.pool_collections": POOL,
        "config.restore": RESTORE,
        "config.shadow_verification": True,
        "config.stop_installs_ratio": 0.5,
        "config.disk_budget_bytes": budget,
    }
    got = {
        "enabled": m.get("enabled"),
        "image": m.get("image"),
        "nodeID": m.get("nodeID"),
        "clickhouseDSN": m.get("clickhouseDSN"),
        "secret.name": (m.get("secret") or {}).get("name"),
        "statusTokenSecret.name": (m.get("statusTokenSecret") or {}).get("name"),
        "restoreSecret.name": (m.get("restoreSecret") or {}).get("name"),
        "reconciler.enabled": (m.get("reconciler") or {}).get("enabled", False),
    }
    got.update({f"config.{k[7:]}": cfg.get(k[7:]) for k in want if k.startswith("config.")})
    wrong = [f"{k} is {got[k]!r}, expected {want[k]!r}" for k in want if got[k] != want[k] or type(got[k]) is not type(want[k])]
    if not snode.get("genesisSnapshotID"):
        wrong.append("storageIntegrity.snode.genesisSnapshotID is missing")
    tables = cfg.get("genesis_tables")
    if not isinstance(tables, list) or not tables or not all(isinstance(t, dict) and t.get("table_id") for t in tables):
        wrong.append(f"config.genesis_tables is {tables!r}, not the network's genesis table list")
    extra = sorted(set(cfg) - (MEMBER_KEYS - {"node_id", "state_dir", "network_id", "clickhouse_dsn", "clickhouse_username", "metrics_listen"}))
    if extra:
        wrong.append(f"config carries keys outside Plan S3-C2 contract §24.2: {extra}")
    if wrong:
        fail(f"{where}: " + "; ".join(wrong))


def cmd_state(phase, si_backup, c, census, image):
    on = started(phase)
    source = Path(TESTS).read_text()
    k = constants(source, TESTS)
    gateway = tuple(census.split(","))
    want = {
        "DEVNET2_P2_STAGE": dict.fromkeys(CHIS, "member"),
        "DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES": gateway,
        "DEVNET2_INDEXER_IDS": dict(zip(RELEASES, (0, 1, int(c)))),
        "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IDS": dict(zip(RELEASES, ("member-a", "member-b", "member-c"))),
        "DEVNET2_MEMBER_IMAGE": image,
        "DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED": {r: r[-1] in on for r in RELEASES},
        "DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS": RELEASES if phase == "monitored" else (),
        "DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS": CHIS if phase == "monitored" else (),
    }
    wrong = [f"{name} is {k[name]!r}, expected {value!r}" for name, value in want.items() if k[name] != value]
    if wrong:
        fail(f"{TESTS}: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    print(f"{TESTS}: every installation at stage member, DEVNET2_GATEWAY_ENGINES {census}, "
          f"members enabled [{', '.join('member-' + x for x in ORDER if x in on)}], "
          f"monitored {'all three' if phase == 'monitored' else 'none'}")
    for x in ("a", "b", "c"):
        h = host(x, c)
        enabled = x in on
        expect_member(yaml.safe_load(Path(h["overlay"]).read_text()), h, enabled, disk_of(si_backup, x) if enabled else 0, image, h["overlay"])
        print(f"{h['overlay']}: siMember {h['member']} as contract §26.5 gives it, "
              + (f"on with disk_budget_bytes {disk_of(si_backup, x)}" if enabled else "off with disk_budget_bytes 0"))
    members = (((yaml.safe_load(Path(SI_OVERLAY).read_text()) or {}).get("monitoring")) or {}).get("members") or {}
    lists = (list(RELEASES), list(CHIS)) if phase == "monitored" else ([], [])
    if (members.get("releases"), members.get("installations")) != lists:
        fail(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: monitoring.members is {members!r}, expected releases {lists[0]} and installations {lists[1]}")
    print(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: monitoring.members releases {lists[0]}, installations {lists[1]}")
    print(f"state {phase} ok")


def git(*args):
    out = subprocess.run(["git", *args], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if out.returncode != 0:
        fail(f"git {' '.join(args)}: {out.stderr.strip()}")
    return out.stdout


def hunks(old, new):
    """(first old line, last old line, old lines, new lines) of every change, 1-based; an insertion has last = first - 1."""
    a, b = old.split("\n"), new.split("\n")
    return [(i1 + 1, i2, a[i1:i2], b[j1:j2])
            for tag, i1, i2, j1, j2 in difflib.SequenceMatcher(None, a, b, autojunk=False).get_opcodes() if tag != "equal"]


def replaced_lines(old, new, where):
    """(old line, new line) of every replaced line; an added or removed line fails."""
    out = []
    for first, last, a, b in hunks(old, new):
        if len(a) != len(b):
            fail(f"{where}: the change adds or removes lines at old line {first}: only replaced lines are expected")
        out.extend(zip(a, b))
    return out


def line_span(source, name):
    node = assignments(source, TESTS)[name]
    return node.lineno, node.end_lineno


def rest_equal(old, new, names):
    def rest(source):
        return [ast.dump(n) for n in ast.parse(source).body
                if not (isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and len(n.targets) == 1 and isinstance(n.targets[0], ast.Name) and n.targets[0].id in names)]
    if rest(old) != rest(new):
        fail(f"the commit changes {TESTS} beyond {', '.join(sorted(names))}")


def check_tests_change(old, new, edits):
    """edits: name -> (old value, new value); nothing else in test_render.py may change."""
    rest_equal(old, new, set(edits))
    covered = {n for name in edits for n in range(line_span(old, name)[0], line_span(old, name)[1] + 1)}
    for first, last, _, _ in hunks(old, new):
        touched = set(range(first, last + 1)) if last >= first else {first - 1, first} & covered or {first}
        if not touched <= covered:
            fail(f"{TESTS} lines {first}-{last} change outside {', '.join(edits)}")
    for name, (before, after) in edits.items():
        if literal(old, name, f"HEAD~1:{TESTS}") != before or literal(new, name, f"HEAD:{TESTS}") != after:
            fail(f"{TESTS}: {name} goes from {literal(old, name, TESTS)!r} to {literal(new, name, TESTS)!r}, "
                 f"expected {before!r} to {after!r}")


def message_ok(subject):
    message = git("log", "-1", "--format=%B").rstrip("\n").split("\n")
    if message[0] != subject:
        fail(f"HEAD's subject is {message[0]!r}, expected {subject!r} (contract §28.2)")
    if message[-1] != TRAILER:
        fail(f"HEAD's message does not end with {TRAILER!r}")


def cmd_commit(kind, x, si_backup, c):
    files = sorted(git("diff", "--name-only", "HEAD~1", "HEAD").split())
    if kind == "member":
        h = host(x, c)
        budget = disk_of(si_backup, x)
        if files != sorted([h["overlay"], TESTS]):
            fail(f"HEAD changes {files}, expected {h['overlay']} and {TESTS}")
        old, new = git("show", f"HEAD~1:{h['overlay']}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{h['overlay']}")
        lines = replaced_lines(old, new, h["overlay"])
        want = [("  enabled: false", "  enabled: true"), ("    disk_budget_bytes: 0", f"    disk_budget_bytes: {budget}")]
        if [(o.rstrip(), n.rstrip()) for o, n in lines] != want:
            fail(f"{h['overlay']}: the changed lines are {lines}, expected {want}")
        a, b = yaml.safe_load(old), yaml.safe_load(new)
        a["siMember"]["enabled"] = True
        a["siMember"]["config"]["disk_budget_bytes"] = budget
        if a != b:
            fail(f"{h['overlay']}: the YAML changes beyond siMember.enabled and siMember.config.disk_budget_bytes")
        expect_member(b, h, True, budget, b["siMember"].get("image"), f"HEAD:{h['overlay']}")
        enabled_before = {r: r[-1] in ORDER[:ORDER.index(x)] for r in RELEASES}
        check_tests_change(git("show", f"HEAD~1:{TESTS}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{TESTS}"),
                           {"DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED": (enabled_before, dict(enabled_before, **{h["release"]: True}))})
        message_ok(h["subject"])
        print(f"HEAD {git('rev-parse', '--short=9', 'HEAD').strip()}: {h['subject']}; {h['overlay']} siMember.enabled false -> true "
              f"and siMember.config.disk_budget_bytes 0 -> {budget} (two lines); {TESTS} DEVNET2_MEMBERS_ENABLED[{h['release']!r}] False -> True")
        print(f"commit member-{x} ok")
    elif kind == "monitoring":
        if x != "-":
            fail("monitoring takes X '-'")
        if files != sorted([SI_OVERLAY, TESTS]):
            fail(f"HEAD changes {files}, expected {SI_OVERLAY} and {TESTS}")
        old, new = git("show", f"HEAD~1:{SI_OVERLAY}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{SI_OVERLAY}")
        a, b = yaml.safe_load(old), yaml.safe_load(new)
        if (a["monitoring"]["members"]["releases"], a["monitoring"]["members"]["installations"]) != ([], []):
            fail(f"HEAD~1:{SI_OVERLAY}: monitoring.members is not the PR's empty lists")
        a["monitoring"]["members"]["releases"] = list(RELEASES)
        a["monitoring"]["members"]["installations"] = list(CHIS)
        if a != b:
            fail(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: the YAML changes beyond monitoring.members.releases and .installations")
        start = next(i for i, line in enumerate(old.split("\n"), 1) if line.rstrip() == "monitoring:")
        end = next((i for i, line in enumerate(old.split("\n"), 1) if i > start and re.match(r"[A-Za-z_]", line)), len(old.split("\n")) + 1)
        for first, last, _, _ in hunks(old, new):
            if not (start < first and max(first, last) < end):
                fail(f"{SI_OVERLAY}: old lines {first}-{last} change outside the monitoring block (lines {start}-{end - 1})")
        check_tests_change(git("show", f"HEAD~1:{TESTS}"), git("show", f"HEAD:{TESTS}"),
                           {"DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS": ((), RELEASES), "DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS": ((), CHIS)})
        message_ok("chore(devnet2): monitor the si-members")
        print(f"HEAD {git('rev-parse', '--short=9', 'HEAD').strip()}: chore(devnet2): monitor the si-members; {SI_OVERLAY} "
              f"monitoring.members releases {list(RELEASES)} and installations {list(CHIS)}; {TESTS} DEVNET2_MONITORED_MEMBERS "
              "and DEVNET2_MEMBER_INSTALLATIONS the same tuples")
        print("commit monitoring ok")
    else:
        fail(f"commit kind {kind!r} is member or monitoring")


def objects(path):
    out = {}
    for doc in yaml.safe_load_all(Path(path).read_text()):
        if doc:
            out[(doc["kind"], doc["metadata"]["name"])] = doc
    return out


def secret_refs(pod_spec):
    refs = set()
    for c in (pod_spec.get("containers") or []) + (pod_spec.get("initContainers") or []):
        for e in c.get("env") or []:
            ref = ((e.get("valueFrom") or {}).get("secretKeyRef") or {}).get("name")
            if ref:
                refs.add(ref)
        for e in c.get("envFrom") or []:
            if (e.get("secretRef") or {}).get("name"):
                refs.add(e["secretRef"]["name"])
    for v in pod_spec.get("volumes") or []:
        if (v.get("secret") or {}).get("secretName"):
            refs.add(v["secret"]["secretName"])
        for s in (v.get("projected") or {}).get("sources") or []:
            if (s.get("secret") or {}).get("name"):
                refs.add(s["secret"]["name"])
    return refs


def secret_keys_in(value, path=""):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        for k, v in value.items():
            if SECRETISH.search(str(k)):
                yield f"{path}{k}"
            yield from secret_keys_in(v, f"{path}{k}.")
    elif isinstance(value, list):
        for i, v in enumerate(value):
            yield from secret_keys_in(v, f"{path}{i}.")


def env_refs(container):
    return sorted(
        (e["name"], ((e.get("valueFrom") or {}).get("secretKeyRef") or {}).get("name"),
         ((e.get("valueFrom") or {}).get("secretKeyRef") or {}).get("key"), "value" in e)
        for e in container.get("env") or [])


def want_env(h):
    return sorted([
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD", h["secret"], "clickhouse-password", False),
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_ACCESS_KEY_ID", h["restore"], "access-id", False),
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_RESTORE_SECRET", h["restore"], "secret", False),
        ("STORAGE_INTEGRITY_MEMBER_STATUS_TOKEN", h["token"], "status-token", False),
    ])


def cmd_render(x, render_file, si_backup, c, image):
    h = host(x, c)
    budget = disk_of(si_backup, x)
    r = h["release"]
    objs = objects(render_file)
    member_objs = sorted(k for k in objs if k[1].startswith(f"{r}-si-member"))
    want_objs = sorted([("ConfigMap", f"{r}-si-member-config"), ("Service", f"{r}-si-member"), ("StatefulSet", f"{r}-si-member")])
    if member_objs != want_objs:
        fail(f"the rendering of {r} holds the member objects {member_objs}, expected {want_objs}")
    overlay = yaml.safe_load(Path(h["overlay"]).read_text())
    si = overlay["storageIntegrity"]
    cm = objs[("ConfigMap", f"{r}-si-member-config")]
    if sorted(cm.get("data") or {}) != ["si-member.yaml"]:
        fail(f"ConfigMap {r}-si-member-config holds {sorted(cm.get('data') or {})}, expected only si-member.yaml")
    text = cm["data"]["si-member.yaml"]
    conf = yaml.safe_load(text)
    if sorted(conf) != ["storage_integrity"] or sorted(conf["storage_integrity"]) != ["arbiter_peers", "member", "payload_store_data_addr"]:
        fail(f"si-member.yaml's keys are {conf!r}, not storage_integrity.{{arbiter_peers, payload_store_data_addr, member}}")
    member = conf["storage_integrity"]["member"]
    want = {
        "node_id": h["member"], "host_indexer_id": h["indexer"], "state_dir": "/data/si-member",
        "network_id": si["snode"]["networkID"], "genesis_snapshot_id": si["snode"]["genesisSnapshotID"],
        "genesis_tables": overlay["siMember"]["config"]["genesis_tables"], "clickhouse_dsn": h["dsn"],
        "clickhouse_username": "si_member", "storage_policy": "member", "peers": h["peers"], "pool_collections": POOL,
        "restore": RESTORE, "shadow_verification": True, "stop_installs_ratio": 0.5, "disk_budget_bytes": budget,
        "metrics_listen": ":9095",
    }
    if set(member) != MEMBER_KEYS:
        fail(f"si-member.yaml's member keys are {sorted(member)}, expected {sorted(MEMBER_KEYS)}")
    wrong = [f"{k} is {member[k]!r}, expected {v!r}" for k, v in want.items() if member[k] != v]
    if conf["storage_integrity"]["arbiter_peers"] != si["arbiterPeers"]:
        wrong.append("arbiter_peers differ from the host's storageIntegrity.arbiterPeers")
    if conf["storage_integrity"]["payload_store_data_addr"] != si["payloadStoreDataAddr"]:
        wrong.append("payload_store_data_addr differs from the host's storageIntegrity.payloadStoreDataAddr")
    leaked = list(secret_keys_in(conf))
    if leaked:
        wrong.append(f"si-member.yaml carries secret-looking keys {leaked}")
    if wrong:
        fail(f"ConfigMap {r}-si-member-config: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    sts = objs[("StatefulSet", f"{r}-si-member")]
    tpl = sts["spec"]["template"]
    spec = tpl["spec"]
    containers = spec.get("containers") or []
    checks = {
        "replicas": (sts["spec"].get("replicas"), 1),
        "containers": ([c_["name"] for c_ in containers], ["si-member"]),
        "initContainers": (spec.get("initContainers"), None),
        "image": (containers[0].get("image") if containers else None, image),
        "command": (containers[0].get("command") if containers else None, ["/sentio-node"]),
        "args": (containers[0].get("args") if containers else None, ["si-member", "--config-path", "/config/si-member.yaml"]),
        "env": (env_refs(containers[0]) if containers else None, want_env(h)),
        "envFrom": (containers[0].get("envFrom") if containers else None, None),
        "ports": (sorted((p["name"], p["containerPort"]) for p in containers[0].get("ports") or []) if containers else None, [("metrics", 9095), ("status", 9096)]),
        "nodeSelector": (spec.get("nodeSelector"), {"sentio.xyz/general": "true"}),
        "automountServiceAccountToken": (spec.get("automountServiceAccountToken"), False),
        "volumes": (sorted((v["name"], (v.get("configMap") or {}).get("name")) for v in spec.get("volumes") or []), [("config", f"{r}-si-member-config")]),
        "volumeClaimTemplates": ([(v["metadata"]["name"], v["spec"].get("storageClassName"), v["spec"]["resources"]["requests"]["storage"]) for v in sts["spec"].get("volumeClaimTemplates") or []], [("si-member-state", "local-path", "1Gi")]),
        "member-id label": (tpl["metadata"]["labels"].get("storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id"), h["member"]),
        "component label": (tpl["metadata"]["labels"].get("app.kubernetes.io/component"), "si-member"),
        "checksum/si-member-config": ((tpl["metadata"].get("annotations") or {}).get("checksum/si-member-config"), hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()),
    }
    wrong = [f"{k} is {got!r}, expected {exp!r}" for k, (got, exp) in checks.items() if got != exp]
    if wrong:
        fail(f"StatefulSet {r}-si-member: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    svc = objs[("Service", f"{r}-si-member")]
    ports = sorted((p["name"], p["port"]) for p in svc["spec"].get("ports") or [])
    if ports != [("metrics", 9095), ("status", 9096)] or svc["spec"].get("selector", {}).get("storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id") != h["member"]:
        fail(f"Service {r}-si-member: ports {ports}, selector {svc['spec'].get('selector')}")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[^@\s]+:[^@\s]+@sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}", image):
        fail(f"the member image {image!r} is not digest-pinned")
    host_sts = objs.get(("StatefulSet", r))
    if host_sts is None:
        fail(f"the rendering of {r} has no host StatefulSet {r}")
    refs = secret_refs(host_sts["spec"]["template"]["spec"])
    if refs & {h["secret"], h["token"], h["restore"]}:
        fail(f"the host StatefulSet {r} references {sorted(refs & {h['secret'], h['token'], h['restore']})}: the member Secrets reach only the si-member container (D29)")
    for (kind, name), doc in objs.items():
        if kind in ("Deployment", "StatefulSet", "DaemonSet", "Job", "CronJob") and name != f"{r}-si-member":
            pod = doc["spec"]["template"]["spec"] if kind != "CronJob" else doc["spec"]["jobTemplate"]["spec"]["template"]["spec"]
            if secret_refs(pod) & {h["secret"], h["token"]}:
                fail(f"{kind} {name} references a member Secret (D29)")
    print(f"rendering of {r}: ConfigMap {r}-si-member-config (si-member.yaml: node_id {h['member']}, host_indexer_id {h['indexer']}, "
          f"clickhouse_dsn {h['dsn']} as si_member, peers {[p['indexer_id'] for p in h['peers']]}, disk_budget_bytes {budget}, "
          f"stop_installs_ratio 0.5, no secret), StatefulSet {r}-si-member (one container si-member on {image}, env only from "
          f"{h['secret']}, {h['token']} and {h['restore']}, checksum of its own config), Service {r}-si-member (metrics 9095, status 9096); "
          f"the host StatefulSet references no member Secret")
    print(f"render member-{x} ok")


def cmd_member_pod(x, line, c, image):
    h = host(x, c)
    try:
        pod = json.loads(line)
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        fail(f"the pod line of member-{x} is not JSON")
    want = {
        "pod": f"{h['release']}-si-member-0",
        "member_id": h["member"],
        "containers": ["si-member"],
        "init": [],
        "image": image,
        "sa_token": False,
        "restarts": 0,
        "env": [dict(zip(("name", "secret", "key", "inline"), e)) for e in want_env(h)],
        "volumes": sorted([
            {"name": "config", "configMap": f"{h['release']}-si-member-config", "secret": None, "pvc": None},
            {"name": "si-member-state", "configMap": None, "secret": None, "pvc": f"si-member-state-{h['release']}-si-member-0"},
        ], key=lambda v: v["name"]),
    }
    got = dict(pod)
    got["env"] = sorted(pod.get("env") or [], key=lambda e: e["name"])
    got["volumes"] = sorted(pod.get("volumes") or [], key=lambda v: v["name"])
    wrong = [f"{k} is {got.get(k)!r}, expected {v!r}" for k, v in want.items() if got.get(k) != v]
    if wrong:
        fail(f"pod {want['pod']}: " + "; ".join(wrong))
    print(f"pod {want['pod']} on node {pod.get('node')} (ready {str(pod.get('ready')).lower()}): one container si-member on the member image, no restart, member id {h['member']}, "
          f"no service-account token, env only from {h['secret']}/clickhouse-password, {h['token']}/status-token and "
          f"{h['restore']}/access-id,secret, volumes config and si-member-state only")
    print(f"member-pod member-{x} ok")


def cmd_room(path, live_now, planned):
    lines = [line.strip() for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines() if BUDGET.search(line.strip())]
    if len(lines) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: expected one budget line of the §13.4 estimator, found {len(lines)}")
    live, _, budget, half = map(int, BUDGET.search(lines[0]).groups())
    if half != budget // 2:
        fail(f"{path}: 'a drill spends at most {half}' is not half of {budget}")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", live_now) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", planned):
        fail(f"LIVE_PROMOTION_SEQ {live_now!r} and PLANNED_WRITES {planned!r} must be decimal")
    spent = int(live_now) - live
    if spent < 0:
        fail(f"the live promotion sequence {live_now} is below the start's {live}")
    if spent + int(planned) > budget // 2:
        fail(f"{spent} promotions since budget-start.txt plus {planned} planned exceed half the budget ({budget // 2}): "
             "P2 stops before writing (contract §27.7)")
    print(f"budget room ok: {spent} promotions since budget-start.txt (live {live} -> {live_now}), {planned} planned, "
          f"{budget // 2 - spent - int(planned)} to spare of half the budget ({budget // 2})")


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) == 6 and argv[0] == "state":
        cmd_state(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 5 and argv[0] == "commit":
        cmd_commit(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 6 and argv[0] == "render":
        cmd_render(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 5 and argv[0] == "member-pod":
        cmd_member_pod(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 4 and argv[0] == "room":
        cmd_room(*argv[1:])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

`t41-record.py`, which writes the record paragraph of runbook §12 and the Appendix C run record from the evidence:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""The records of Plan S3-C3 Task 41 (a throwaway tool, never committed).

  t41-record.py paragraph SI_BACKUP T41
  t41-record.py insert RUNBOOK PARAGRAPH_FILE
  t41-record.py ledger SI_BACKUP T41 RECORD_PR

paragraph prints the record of the run for the end of runbook §12, one line
built only from the evidence the runbook's blocks wrote under SI_BACKUP, the
ledger values Task 41 read (T41/ledger-41.env) and the time member-b's window
passed (T41/member-b-ok); a missing or malformed piece of evidence stops it. insert puts that line into RUNBOOK (a checkout's
docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md) right after the line
"The record of each run of this runbook follows this paragraph, added by its
outcome record PR (docs only).", followed by "## 13. Rollback" as before, and
refuses a runbook that has the anchor other than once in §12 or holds a
record already. ledger prints the run record of P2_END for Appendix C (one
paragraph, then the steady state after P2 for Plan S3-C4 as "- " lines).
"""

import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ANCHOR = "The record of each run of this runbook follows this paragraph, added by its outcome record PR (docs only)."
HOSTS = ("a", "v1", "v2", "v3", "b", "c")


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"t41-record: {message}; nothing written; stop")


def read(si_backup, name):
    path = Path(si_backup, name)
    if not path.is_file() or not path.read_text().strip():
        fail(f"{path} is missing or empty")
    return path.read_text()


def one(text, pattern, where):
    found = re.findall(pattern, text, re.M)
    if len(found) != 1:
        fail(f"{where}: expected one line matching {pattern!r}, found {len(found)}")
    return found[0]


def ledger_values(path):
    values = {}
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        if "=" in line:
            key, value = line.split("=", 1)
            values[key] = value
    for key in ("SN_COMMIT_P2", "SN_DIGEST_P2", "INDEXER_C_ID", "P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK", "ARBITER_PIN_P2", "P2_PR", "MEMBER_IDS"):
        if not values.get(key):
            fail(f"{path} has no {key}")
    return values


def evidence(si_backup, t41):
    v = ledger_values(Path(t41, "ledger-41.env"))
    e = {"ledger": v}
    start = read(si_backup, "soak-start").split()
    end = read(si_backup, "soak-end").split()
    if len(start) != 4 or len(end) != 4:
        fail("soak-start or soak-end is not '<date> <time> <epoch> <sealed>'")
    e["start"], e["end"] = start, end
    e["hours"] = (int(end[2]) - int(start[2])) / 3600
    e["k"] = read(si_backup, "soak-k").strip()
    first = read(t41, "member-b-ok").strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]T[0-9:]{8}Z", first):
        fail(f"{t41}/member-b-ok holds {first!r}, not the UTC time member-b's window passed")
    e["first"] = first[:10]
    e["commits"] = {}
    for name in ("p2-member-member-b-commit", "p2-member-member-c-commit", "p2-member-member-a-commit", "p2-monitoring-commit"):
        sha = read(si_backup, name).strip()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", sha):
            fail(f"{name} holds {sha!r}, not a commit")
        e["commits"][name] = sha
    e["disks"] = {}
    for x in ("a", "b", "c"):
        total = read(si_backup, f"member-disk-{x}").strip()
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", total):
            fail(f"member-disk-{x} holds {total!r}")
        e["disks"][x] = total
    boot = read(si_backup, "bootstrap.txt")
    one(boot, r"^(copies equal: 6 of 6)$", "bootstrap.txt")
    installs = {src: sum(int(float(n)) for n in re.findall(r'^sentio_node_si_member_installs_total\{source="%s"\} ([0-9.e+]+)$' % src, boot, re.M))
                for src in ("restore", "owner_pull", "peer_unsafe_pull")}
    if installs["restore"] <= 0 or installs["owner_pull"] <= 0:
        fail(f"bootstrap.txt shows installs {installs}: none from restore or none by owner pull (runbook §9)")
    e["bootstrap"] = (f"every copy reached its owner's latest published entry, 6 of 6, with {installs['restore']} installs "
                      f"from the P1 backups by restore, {installs['owner_pull']} by owner pull and {installs['peer_unsafe_pull']} "
                      "by peer pull across the three members")
    for r in (1, 2, 3):
        one(read(si_backup, f"soak-round-R{r}.txt"), r"^(round ok: .*)$", f"soak-round-R{r}.txt")
    m = read(si_backup, "measurements.txt")
    one(m, r"^(soak ok: .*)$", "measurements.txt")
    one(m, r"^(every soak block evaluated with quorum)$", "measurements.txt")
    one(m, r"^StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind fired in the last 24 h: (\[\])$", "measurements.txt")
    one(m, r"^StorageIntegrityMemberShadowMismatch fired in the soak: (\[\])$", "measurements.txt")
    e["blocks"] = one(m, r"^blocks ([0-9]+ to [0-9]+: [0-9]+ sealed), per owner \(non-transition\): .*$", "measurements.txt")
    e["per_owner"] = {str(d["owner"]): d["blocks"] for d in json.loads(one(m, r"^blocks [0-9]+ to [0-9]+: [0-9]+ sealed, per owner \(non-transition\): (\[.*\])$", "measurements.txt"))}
    e["shadow"] = re.findall(r"^(member-[abc]) owner ([0-9]+): shadowed \+([0-9]+) of ([0-9]+) sealed non-transition blocks, \+([0-9]+) mismatches, \+([0-9]+) missed scans, \+([0-9]+) unverdicted$", m, re.M)
    if len(e["shadow"]) != 6 or any(s[4] != "0" for s in e["shadow"]):
        fail("measurements.txt does not hold six soak verdict lines with zero mismatches")
    e["ratio_max"] = one(m, r"^soak from .*; member disk used ratio max ([0-9.]+)$", "measurements.txt")
    e["disk_used"] = dict(re.findall(r"^member-([abc]) disk: .*; used ([0-9.]+)$", m, re.M))
    e["member_bytes"] = {x: (p, d) for x, p, d in re.findall(r"^member-([abc]) bytes on disk member: parts ([0-9]*), detached ([0-9]*)$", m, re.M)}
    if sorted(e["disk_used"]) != ["a", "b", "c"] or sorted(e["member_bytes"]) != ["a", "b", "c"]:
        fail("measurements.txt lacks a member disk or member bytes line")
    one(read(si_backup, "copies.jsonl"), r"^(copies equal: 6 of 6)$", "copies.jsonl")
    probe = read(si_backup, "exit-probe.txt")
    e["probe"] = dict(re.findall(r"^member probe ok on (a|v1|v2|v3|b|c) \(([0-9]+) rows\)$", probe, re.M))
    if sorted(e["probe"]) != sorted(HOSTS):
        fail(f"exit-probe.txt has 'member probe ok' for {sorted(e['probe'])}, expected all six SI ClickHouses")
    one(read(si_backup, "soak-drops.txt"), r"^(copies left of the soak tables: none)$", "soak-drops.txt")
    e["budget_start"] = one(read(si_backup, "budget-start.txt"), r"^(snapshot .* a drill spends at most [0-9]+)$", "budget-start.txt")
    e["spent"] = one(read(si_backup, "budget-end.txt"), r"^(P2 spent [0-9]+ promotions \(live [0-9]+ -> [0-9]+\) of a budget of [0-9]+; half is [0-9]+)$", "budget-end.txt")
    e["p2_end"] = one(read(si_backup, "p2-end.txt"), r"^P2_END=(20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9])$", "p2-end.txt")
    if read(si_backup, "p2-end.txt").rstrip("\n").split("\n")[-1] != f"P2_END={e['p2_end']}":
        fail("p2-end.txt does not end with its P2_END line")
    return e


def paragraph(e):
    v = e["ledger"]
    c = v["INDEXER_C_ID"]
    sh = {(s[0], s[1]): s for s in e["shadow"]}
    shadow = "; ".join(f"{mem} shadowed {sh[(mem, o)][2]} of owner {o}'s {sh[(mem, o)][3]} sealed blocks ({sh[(mem, o)][5]} missed scans, {sh[(mem, o)][6]} unverdicted)"
                       for mem, owners in (("member-b", ("0", c)), ("member-c", ("0", "1")), ("member-a", ("1", c))) for o in owners if (mem, o) in sh)
    if shadow.count("shadowed") != 6:
        fail(f"the soak verdict lines do not name the peer owners of INDEXER_C_ID {c}")
    bytes_ = ", ".join(f"{x} {e['member_bytes'][x][0] or 0} bytes of parts and {e['member_bytes'][x][1] or 0} detached, filesystem {e['disk_used'][x]} used" for x in ("b", "c", "a"))
    probe = ", ".join(f"{h} {e['probe'][h]}" for h in HOSTS)
    cm = e["commits"]
    return (
        f"Record of the first run: {e['first']} to {e['p2_end']} (UTC), every mutating block confirmed by the user in chat, "
        f"the devuser1 owner's soak writes and drops run by the user in their own terminal. "
        f"The si-members started one per window in the order member-b, member-c, member-a on "
        f"`ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-{v['SN_COMMIT_P2']}@{v['SN_DIGEST_P2']}` (commits "
        f"`{cm['p2-member-member-b-commit'][:9]}`, `{cm['p2-member-member-c-commit'][:9]}`, `{cm['p2-member-member-a-commit'][:9]}`), "
        f"each in its own StatefulSet with `disk_budget_bytes` its member disk's total (member-b {e['disks']['b']}, member-c "
        f"{e['disks']['c']}, member-a {e['disks']['a']}) and `stop_installs_ratio` 0.5; no host pod, host StatefulSet or source "
        f"ClickHouse changed in a member window. The member monitoring went live with commit `{cm['p2-monitoring-commit'][:9]}`. "
        f"Bootstrap: {e['bootstrap']}. "
        f"Shadow soak from {e['start'][0]} {e['start'][1]} to {e['end'][0]} {e['end'][1]} UTC ({e['hours']:.1f} h, blocks {e['blocks']}; "
        f"non-transition blocks per owner {', '.join(f'{o}: {n}' for o, n in sorted(e['per_owner'].items(), key=lambda t: int(t[0])))}), "
        f"three write rounds of {e['k']} writes per owner, every round passed: {shadow}; zero mismatches, every soak block evaluated "
        f"with quorum, `StorageIntegrityMemberCopyBehind` silent over the last 24 h and every copy at its owner's latest published "
        f"entry at the end (6 of 6). Member disks at most {e['ratio_max']} used during the soak; at the end {bytes_}. "
        f"The exit probe as `si_member` refused every row on all six SI ClickHouses (rows: {probe}). The soak tables "
        f"`devuser1.s3_p2` and `s3_p2` of indexer-c's acceptance database were dropped and no member keeps a copy. "
        f"Promotion budget at the start: {e['budget_start']}; at the end: {e['spent']}. "
        f"The 500-blocks-per-owner criterion is Plan S3-C2's release-path soak (`P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK` {v['P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK']} "
        f"at arbiter `{v['ARBITER_PIN_P2'][:9]}`). `P2_END` {e['p2_end']}."
    )


def cmd_paragraph(si_backup, t41):
    text = paragraph(evidence(si_backup, t41))
    if "\n" in text:
        fail("the record is not one line")
    print(text)


def cmd_insert(runbook, paragraph_file):
    record = Path(paragraph_file).read_text().strip()
    if not record.startswith("Record of the first run: ") or "\n" in record:
        fail(f"{paragraph_file} is not one 'Record of the first run:' line")
    text = Path(runbook).read_text()
    if text.count("\n## 12. End\n") != 1 or text.count("\n## 13. Rollback\n") != 1:
        fail(f"{runbook}: expected one '## 12. End' and one '## 13. Rollback' heading")
    head, rest = text.split("\n## 12. End\n", 1)
    section, tail = rest.split("\n## 13. Rollback\n", 1)
    if section.count(ANCHOR + "\n") != 1 or text.count(ANCHOR) != 1:
        fail(f"{runbook}: the anchor line is not once in §12")
    if "Record of the first run:" in text:
        fail(f"{runbook} holds a record already")
    before, after = section.split(ANCHOR + "\n", 1)
    if after.strip():
        fail(f"{runbook}: §12 has text after the anchor line")
    new = head + "\n## 12. End\n" + before + ANCHOR + "\n\n" + record + "\n" + "\n## 13. Rollback\n" + tail
    Path(runbook).write_text(new)
    print(f"{runbook}: the record of the first run follows the anchor of §12 ({len(record)} characters)")


def cmd_ledger(si_backup, t41, record_pr):
    e = evidence(si_backup, t41)
    v = e["ledger"]
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", record_pr):
        fail(f"RECORD_PR {record_pr!r} is not a PR number")
    cm = e["commits"]
    lines = [
        f"{e['p2_end']} UTC (runbook §12's p2-end.txt), P2 runbook docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md "
        f"(production PR #{v['P2_PR']}) §8 to §12 on devnet2, every mutating block confirmed by the user in chat: the si-members "
        f"member-b, member-c and member-a started one host per window and bootstrapped ({e['bootstrap']}), "
        f"and shadow-verified every block of their two peer owners sealed in a soak of {e['hours']:.1f} h (blocks {e['blocks']}) with zero "
        f"mismatches, three write rounds of {e['k']} writes per owner, within half the promotion budget: {e['spent']}; the copies "
        f"stayed at the latest published entries, the member disks below 50 % (at most {e['ratio_max']}), and the exit probe refused "
        f"every row as si_member on all six SI ClickHouses; the soak tables are dropped. The 500-blocks-per-owner criterion is "
        f"Plan S3-C2's P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK {v['P2_INTEGRATION_SOAK']} (K38, D38). Record PR sentioxyz/production#{record_pr} "
        f"(runbook §12); evidence under $HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2.",
        f"- si-members (off consensus, never registered): member-a on indexer-a (SI indexer 0), member-b on indexer-b (1), member-c "
        f"on indexer-c ({v['INDEXER_C_ID']}), each the StatefulSet <release>-si-member of its host release on "
        f"ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-{v['SN_COMMIT_P2']}@{v['SN_DIGEST_P2']}, copying the other two owners into hg_replica "
        f"on its host's source ClickHouse (disk member, disk_budget_bytes a {e['disks']['a']}, b {e['disks']['b']}, c "
        f"{e['disks']['c']}, stop_installs_ratio 0.5), shadow verification on, the reconciler slot off",
        f"- commits on production main: member-b {cm['p2-member-member-b-commit'][:12]}, member-c {cm['p2-member-member-c-commit'][:12]}, "
        f"member-a {cm['p2-member-member-a-commit'][:12]}, monitoring {cm['p2-monitoring-commit'][:12]} (VMServiceScrape "
        f"storage-integrity-si-v2-members and the rule group storage-integrity-si-v2.members)",
        "- steady state for Plan S3-C4: every installation at stage member (si_member with its collection grants, si_member_ddl "
        "nowhere, table_engines_require_grant on), UNSAFE_INC_ROOT empty, every member running and monitored with no member alert "
        "firing, its copies following both peer owners; the members serve no reads yet (P3 adds the serving listener and the "
        "status token's use)",
    ]
    print("\n".join(lines))


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) == 3 and argv[0] == "paragraph":
        cmd_paragraph(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 3 and argv[0] == "insert":
        cmd_insert(*argv[1:])
    elif len(argv) == 4 and argv[0] == "ledger":
        cmd_ledger(*argv[1:])
    else:
        sys.exit(__doc__)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
```

`t41-user-block.sh`, which runs one of the `devuser1` owner's runbook blocks in the user's own terminal:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Run one of the devuser1 owner's blocks of docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md in the user's own terminal (Plan S3-C3 Task 41).
#
#   bash ~/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session/task41/t41-user-block.sh <block> <key file of devuser1's owner>
#
# From fish this is an ordinary command. <block> is soak-R1-b, soak-R2-b, soak-R3-b (§10: owner 1's k writes into
# devuser1.s3_p2 in round 1, 2 or 3), soak-R1-c, soak-R2-c, soak-R3-c (§10: owner INDEXER_C_ID's k writes into
# <acceptance-db>.s3_p2), drop-b or drop-c (§12: DROP TABLE of that soak table). The block is taken from the live
# checkout's runbook, the one confirmed block of its section whose first line is key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key
# and which writes that block's evidence file, and runs verbatim in bash with set -eo pipefail, the session helpers
# defined and the live checkout as its directory. Only its runtime lines change, as the runbook says to set them: the
# first line becomes the key file given here, and in a soak block the line r=1 becomes that round. si_agent_start
# reads the key into HOUSEGATE_AGENT_KEY: it never reaches argv, this terminal or the chat. The agent's gate for that
# block must have passed first (task41/gate-<block> in the session); the block as run is kept as
# task41/user-<block>.sh and its output as task41/user-<block>.out, and a block that ran once is
# refused (a write is never re-run).
# shellcheck disable=SC2154  # si_backup and P come from helpers.sh
set -eo pipefail
usage="usage: bash ~/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session/task41/t41-user-block.sh soak-R1-b|soak-R2-b|soak-R3-b|soak-R1-c|soak-R2-c|soak-R3-c|drop-b|drop-c <key file>"
[ "$#" = 2 ] || { echo "$usage"; exit 2; }
case "$1" in soak-R[123]-[bc]|drop-[bc]) ;; *) echo "$1 is not one of Task 41's devuser1 blocks; $usage"; exit 2 ;; esac
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session/helpers.sh"
T41="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session/task41"
[ -d "$si_backup" ] || { echo "$si_backup does not exist: Task 40 has not run"; exit 1; }
[ -e "$T41/gate-$1" ] || { echo "the agent's gate for $1 has not passed ($T41/gate-$1 is missing): ask the agent first"; exit 1; }
[ ! -e "$T41/user-$1.sh" ] || { echo "$T41/user-$1.sh exists: that block ran already; never re-run it (read $T41/user-$1.out instead)"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$2" ] && [ -r "$2" ] || { echo "$2 is not a readable key file"; exit 1; }
key="$(cd "$(dirname "$2")" && pwd)/$(basename "$2")"
block="$T41/user-$1.sh"
python3 -I - "$P/docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md" "$1" "$key" "$block" <<'PY'
import re
import shlex
import sys

runbook, name, key, out = sys.argv[1:]
kind, _, rest = name.partition("-")
if kind == "soak":
    rnd, owner = rest[1], rest[3]
    heading, evidence = "## 10. Shadow soak", f'"$si_backup/soak-writes-R$r-{owner}.txt"'
else:
    rnd, owner = None, rest
    heading, evidence = "## 12. End", f'"$si_backup/soak-drop-{owner}.txt"'
first = "key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key"
# The bash blocks of that section, found by their fences line by line (decision D24), as the session's helpers
# extractor finds them; a heading counts only outside a block, and so does the line before a block.
found, current, previous, fence, body, confirmed = [], None, "", None, None, False
for line in open(runbook).read().split("\n"):
    if fence is None:
        opening = re.match(r"(`{3,})([^`\s]*)\s*$", line)
        if opening:
            fence = opening.group(1)
            body = [] if opening.group(2) == "bash" and current == heading else None
            confirmed = previous == "Confirm before running."
            continue
        if re.match(r"#{2,3} ", line):
            current = line
        if line.strip():
            previous = line.strip()
    elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
        if body and body[0] == first and any(l.rstrip().endswith("| tee " + evidence) for l in body):
            found.append((confirmed, body))
        fence, body, previous = None, None, line.strip()
    elif body is not None:
        body.append(line)
if len(found) != 1:
    sys.exit(f"t41-user-block: expected one block of '{heading}' starting {first!r} that tees into {evidence}, found {len(found)}")
confirmed, body = found[0]
if not confirmed:
    sys.exit(f"t41-user-block: the {name} block is not a confirmed block of the runbook")
lines = ["key_file=%s" % shlex.quote(key)] + body[1:]
if kind == "soak":
    if lines[1] != "r=1":
        sys.exit(f"t41-user-block: the {name} block's second line is {lines[1]!r}, not the runbook's r=1")
    lines[1] = f"r={rnd}"
with open(out, "w") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
PY
chmod 600 "$block"
cd "$P"
echo "running the runbook block $1 (kept as $block, output in $T41/user-$1.out)"
# shellcheck disable=SC1090
{ source "$block"; } 2>&1 | tee "$T41/user-$1.out"
```

`task41.sh`, this task's shell helpers, sourced by every block of this task after the session's `helpers.sh`:

```bash
# Plan S3-C3 Task 41's own helpers (never committed), sourced by this task's block files right after the
# session's helpers.sh (the P2 runbook's §0 chain and P). They read the cluster, git and local files and
# write only under $si_backup and $T41. None reads, prints or passes a password, token or key: pods are read
# as names and Secret references only, Secrets as key names only (si_secret_keys), and a chart rendering,
# which may hold values from git, lives only in a temporary directory that is removed again. None changes
# the cluster, a pod or git.
# shellcheck shell=bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2154  # si_backup, P, si_p2_helmfile and the si_* helpers come from helpers.sh
T41="$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-session/task41"
t41_ledger() { # $1 NAME: its value as Step 1 read it from the ledger copy (ledger-41.env)
  local v
  v="$(sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$T41/ledger-41.env" | tail -n 1)"
  [ -n "$v" ] || { echo "t41_ledger: $1 is not in $T41/ledger-41.env" >&2; return 1; }
  printf '%s\n' "$v"
}
t41_image() { printf 'ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-%s@%s\n' "$(t41_ledger SN_COMMIT_P2)" "$(t41_ledger SN_DIGEST_P2)"; } # the member image of the ledger
t41_release() { # $1 a|b|c: that host's sentio-node release
  case "$1" in a|b|c) echo "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$1" ;; *) echo "t41_release: the host is a, b or c, not '$1'" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
}
t41_installation() { # $1 a|b|c: the installation of that host's source ClickHouse
  case "$1" in a) echo network ;; b) echo indexer-b ;; c) echo indexer-c ;; *) echo "t41_installation: the host is a, b or c, not '$1'" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
}
t41_check() { python3 -I "$T41/t41-check.py" "$@"; } # the independent checks, from the live checkout's root
t41_secret_users() { # $1 Secret: every pod of the namespace that references it (env, envFrom, volumes), by name, sorted
  si_kubectl get pods -o json | jq -r --arg s "$1" '.items[] | select(([.spec.containers[]?, .spec.initContainers[]?] | map(((.env // [])[] | .valueFrom.secretKeyRef.name? // empty), ((.envFrom // [])[] | .secretRef.name? // empty))) + [.spec.volumes[]? | (.secret.secretName? // empty), ((.projected.sources // [])[] | .secret.name? // empty)] | index($s)) | .metadata.name' | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' '
}
t41_host_state() { # $1 a|b|c: the host pod (uid, restarts per container, the Secrets it references by name), the host StatefulSet (generation, revisions) and the host's source ClickHouse pod (uid, restarts)
  local r ch
  r="$(t41_release "$1")" || return 2
  ch="$(si_ch_pod "$1")" || return 2
  si_kubectl get pod "$r-0" -o json | jq -r '"host \(.metadata.name) uid=\(.metadata.uid) restarts=\([.status.containerStatuses[]? | "\(.name):\(.restartCount)"] | sort | join(",")) secrets=\(([.spec.containers[]?, .spec.initContainers[]?] | map(((.env // [])[] | .valueFrom.secretKeyRef.name? // empty), ((.envFrom // [])[] | .secretRef.name? // empty))) + [.spec.volumes[]? | (.secret.secretName? // empty), ((.projected.sources // [])[] | .secret.name? // empty)] | unique | join(","))"' || return 1
  si_kubectl get statefulset "$r" -o jsonpath='sts {.metadata.name} generation={.metadata.generation} current={.status.currentRevision} update={.status.updateRevision}{"\n"}' || return 1
  si_kubectl get pod "$ch" -o json | jq -r '"clickhouse \(.metadata.name) uid=\(.metadata.uid) restarts=\([.status.containerStatuses[]? | "\(.name):\(.restartCount)"] | sort | join(","))"'
}
t41_member_pod() { # $1 a|b|c: the si-member pod as one JSON line: names, labels, image, readiness, restarts, each env entry's Secret and key (whether it has an inline value, never the value) and each volume's source
  si_kubectl get pod "$(si_member_pod "$1")" -o json | jq -c '{pod: .metadata.name, node: .spec.nodeName, member_id: .metadata.labels["storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id"],
    containers: [.spec.containers[].name], init: [.spec.initContainers[]?.name], image: .spec.containers[0].image,
    ready: .status.containerStatuses[0].ready, restarts: .status.containerStatuses[0].restartCount, sa_token: .spec.automountServiceAccountToken,
    env: [.spec.containers[0].env[]? | {name, secret: .valueFrom.secretKeyRef.name?, key: .valueFrom.secretKeyRef.key?, inline: has("value")}],
    volumes: [.spec.volumes[]? | {name, configMap: .configMap.name?, secret: .secret.secretName?, pvc: .persistentVolumeClaim.claimName?}]}'
}
t41_member_objects() { # $1 a|b|c: the member's Service ports and selector, and its state claim
  local r
  r="$(t41_release "$1")" || return 2
  si_kubectl get service "$r-si-member" -o json | jq -c '{service: .metadata.name, ports: [.spec.ports[] | {name, port}], member_id: .spec.selector["storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/member-id"]}' || return 1
  si_kubectl get pvc "si-member-state-$r-si-member-0" -o jsonpath='pvc {.metadata.name} {.status.phase} {.spec.storageClassName} {.spec.resources.requests.storage}{"\n"}'
}
t41_render_check() { # $1 a|b|c: renders that host release at the checkout's HEAD into a temporary directory, runs t41-check.py render on it and removes the rendering (local only)
  local d rc=0
  d="$(mktemp -d)" || return 1
  helmfile -f "$si_p2_helmfile" template --selector "name=$(t41_release "$1")" --skip-deps > "$d/render.yaml" 2> "$d/render.err" || { tail -n 20 "$d/render.err" >&2; rc=1; }
  [ "$rc" != 0 ] || t41_check render "$1" "$d/render.yaml" "$si_backup" "$(t41_ledger INDEXER_C_ID)" "$(t41_image)" || rc=1
  rm -rf "$d"
  return "$rc"
}
t41_member_disk() { # $1 a|b|c: the disk member of that host's source ClickHouse, as admin: name, path, total_space, free_space, keep_free_space and the DiskTotal_member metric (TSV)
  si_ch_admin "$1" "SELECT name, path, total_space, free_space, keep_free_space, (SELECT toUInt64(value) FROM system.asynchronous_metrics WHERE metric = 'DiskTotal_member') FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'member' FORMAT TSV"
}
t41_live_seq() { si_show | jq -r .promotion_seq; } # the live promotion sequence
t41_room() { # $1 writes still planned: refuses unless the promotions since budget-start.txt plus these stay within half the budget
  t41_check room "$si_backup/budget-start.txt" "$(t41_live_seq)" "$1"
}
t41_rounds_needed() { # $1 round 1, 2 or 3: the soak writes still to come from that round's start (three owners, k each)
  echo $(( (4 - $1) * 3 * $(cat "$si_backup/soak-k") ))
}
t41_blockowners_copies() { # one line per voter: whether its arbiter container holds the current /tmp/blockowners of runbook §1.3 (read-only)
  local sum i got
  sum="$(shasum -a 256 "$si_backup/tools/blockowners" | cut -d' ' -f1)" || return 1
  for i in 0 1 2; do
    got="$(si_arbiter "$i" sh -c 'sha256sum /tmp/blockowners 2>/dev/null | cut -d" " -f1' || true)"
    if [ "$got" = "$sum" ]; then echo "arbiter-$i: /tmp/blockowners current"; else echo "arbiter-$i: /tmp/blockowners missing or stale"; fi
  done
}
t41_member_alerts() { si_vm_query 'ALERTS{alertname=~"StorageIntegrityMember.*"}' | jq -c '[.data.result[] | .metric]'; } # every member alert pending or firing now
t41_window_before() { # $1 a|b|c: before a member window (runbook §8): the members before it in the order b, c, a passed their windows, no member object or pod for this one, and the host's state recorded
  local x="$1" r i prev
  r="$(t41_release "$x")" || return 2
  i="$(t41_installation "$x")"
  case "$x" in b) prev="" ;; c) prev=b ;; a) prev=c ;; esac
  [ -z "$prev" ] || [ -e "$T41/member-$prev-ok" ] || { echo "member-$prev has not passed its window (the order is b, c, a)" >&2; return 1; }
  [ ! -e "$T41/host-$x-before.txt" ] || { echo "member-$x's window started already: read $T41/host-$x-before.txt" >&2; return 1; }
  [ "$(si_kubectl get statefulset,configmap,service -l "app.kubernetes.io/instance=$r,app.kubernetes.io/component=si-member" -o name | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = 0 ] || { echo "a si-member object of $r exists already" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -z "$(si_kubectl get pvc "si-member-state-$r-si-member-0" --ignore-not-found -o name)" ] || { echo "the state claim si-member-state-$r-si-member-0 exists (an earlier start of member-$x): stop and ask" >&2; return 1; }
  [ -z "$(t41_secret_users "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i")$(t41_secret_users "$r-si-member-status-token")" ] || { echo "a pod references storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i or $r-si-member-status-token already" >&2; return 1; }
  t41_host_state "$x" > "$T41/host-$x-before.txt" || return 1
  cat "$T41/host-$x-before.txt"
  echo "member-$x: no member object and no pod references its two Secrets; the host's state is recorded"
}
t41_window_commit() { # $1 a|b|c: after runbook §8's local commit block: HEAD is one commit on origin/main, exactly that member's commit, and the release renders the member as contract §26.2 gives it (local only)
  git fetch -q origin main || return 1
  [ "$(git rev-parse HEAD~1)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" ] || { echo "HEAD is not one commit on origin/main" >&2; return 1; }
  t41_check commit member "$1" "$si_backup" "$(t41_ledger INDEXER_C_ID)" || return 1
  t41_render_check "$1"
}
t41_window_after() { # $1 a|b|c: after runbook §8's start check: the host unchanged, the member pod, Service and claim as contract §26.2 gives them, its two Secrets used by its own pod only (D29), no restart; writes $T41/member-<x>-ok
  local x="$1" r i f
  r="$(t41_release "$x")" || return 2
  i="$(t41_installation "$x")"
  f="$T41/member-$x-checks.txt"
  t41_host_state "$x" > "$T41/host-$x-after.txt" || return 1
  {
    if diff "$T41/host-$x-before.txt" "$T41/host-$x-after.txt"; then echo "host $r unchanged: its pod, StatefulSet and source ClickHouse and the Secrets its pod references"; fi
    t41_check member-pod "$x" "$(t41_member_pod "$x")" "$(t41_ledger INDEXER_C_ID)" "$(t41_image)"
    t41_member_objects "$x"
    echo "pods using storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i: $(t41_secret_users "storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i")"
    echo "pods using $r-si-member-status-token: $(t41_secret_users "$r-si-member-status-token")"
  } 2>&1 | tee "$f"
  grep -qx "host $r unchanged: its pod, StatefulSet and source ClickHouse and the Secrets its pod references" "$f" || { echo "the member window changed host $r: stop and ask for runbook §13's member revert" >&2; return 1; }
  grep -qx "member-pod member-$x ok" "$f" || { echo "member-$x's pod is not as contract §26.2 gives it" >&2; return 1; }
  grep -qxF "{\"service\":\"$r-si-member\",\"ports\":[{\"name\":\"metrics\",\"port\":9095},{\"name\":\"status\",\"port\":9096}],\"member_id\":\"member-$x\"}" "$f" || { echo "Service $r-si-member is not metrics 9095 and status 9096 on member-$x" >&2; return 1; }
  grep -qx "pvc si-member-state-$r-si-member-0 Bound local-path 1Gi" "$f" || { echo "member-$x's state claim is not a bound 1Gi local-path claim" >&2; return 1; }
  grep -qx "pods using storage-integrity-si-v2-member-$i: $r-si-member-0 " "$f" && grep -qx "pods using $r-si-member-status-token: $r-si-member-0 " "$f" || { echo "a pod other than $r-si-member-0 references the member password or token Secret (D29)" >&2; return 1; }
```

## Appendix A: binding contract (continues the Appendix A of Plans S3-A §0–§6, S3-B §7–§15, S3-C1 §16–§19 and S3-C2 §20–§24)

The earlier plans' contracts stay binding; this appendix continues the numbering, so `contract §N` means the same thing in every stage-3 plan. Every name below is binding verbatim for every task of Plan S3-C3. A task that needs a name not listed here adds it in its own section and records it in Appendix B; it never renames one listed here. Names this plan takes from Plans S3-C1 and S3-C2 are spelled as their contracts give them (the cross-plan consistency pass reconciled them, §28.7); if one of those contracts changes a name, its spelling wins.

### 25. The P2 server bundle, engine grants, member users and collections (Task 37)

#### 25.1 What Plan S3-C3 changes (read first)

- No consensus format change and no consensus update: no Raft command, tag, Raft-reachable field, snapshot version (it stays 20), header byte or feature string; `arbiter.LocalNodeFeatures()` and every arbiter, verifier and SNode image are unchanged (voters on `ARBITER_DIGEST`, hosts on `SN_DIGEST`). The only new process, the si-member (`SN_DIGEST_P2`), is never registered and calls only `SafeState.GetSafeWatermark`, `GetManifest`, `GetBlockVerification` and DA `GetPayload`; it never reaches Raft (Plan S3-C2 contract §20–§24).
- What changes on devnet2: the users and grants of every SI installation (users reloads), one restart of every SI ClickHouse (the bundle of §25.3), one Keeper znode (`UNSAFE_INC_ROOT`), three si-member StatefulSets, the members' `hg_replica` and `hg_rstage` tables on the member disks, the member monitoring, and two soak tables on owners 1 and `INDEXER_C_ID` (created and dropped again).
- Every step can be undone without consensus (runbook §13), except that the member ids stay allocated, `unsafe_inc` stays, and undoing the bundle costs another restart.

#### 25.3 The server bundle (one restart, K39)

Rendered only at an installation's `restarted` stage (§25.12 `DEVNET2_P2_STAGE`), all at once, as `configuration.files` entries and the container env of §25.2. Verbatim (block scalars, two-space XML indent):

- `zz-pool-settings.xml` (replaces Plan S3-B's text, `background_fetches_pool_size` 8 → 16):
  ```xml
  <clickhouse>
    <background_pool_size>16</background_pool_size>
    <background_fetches_pool_size>16</background_fetches_pool_size>
  </clickhouse>
  ```
- `zz-si-access-control.xml`:
  ```xml
  <clickhouse>
    <access_control_improvements>
      <table_engines_require_grant>true</table_engines_require_grant>
    </access_control_improvements>
  </clickhouse>
  ```
- `zz-si-replicated-merge-tree.xml`:
  ```xml
  <clickhouse>
    <replicated_merge_tree>
      <max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool>0</max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool>
    </replicated_merge_tree>
  </clickhouse>
  ```
- `zz-si-storage.xml` on `network` and `indexer-b` (indexer-c keeps Plan S3-B Task 19's file, whose only differences are the path `/var/lib/clickhouse-member/` and its own copy of the same value): Plan S3-B Task 19's `zz-si-storage.xml` text (contract §13) with `<path>/var/lib/clickhouse/disks/member/</path>` and `<keep_free_space_bytes>` = `DEVNET2_KEEP_FREE_SPACE_BYTES` on both `default` and `member`, policy `member` with volume `main` on disk `member` alone (K40).
- `zz-si-named-collections.xml`, one element per collection of §25.2 defined on that installation, in §25.2's order, e.g. on `indexer-b`:
  ```xml
  <clickhouse>
    <named_collections>
      <si_owner_0>
        <host overridable="false">storage-integrity-si-v2-source</host>
        <port overridable="false">9000</port>
        <user overridable="false">si_reader</user>
        <password overridable="false" from_env="SI_READER_PASSWORD_NETWORK"/>
      </si_owner_0>
      ...
    </named_collections>
  </clickhouse>
  ```
  A config-defined collection's override refusal is measured in the staging proof (runbook §3): expected code 36 `Override not allowed for '<key>'`, as Plan S3-A M8 measured for the SQL form; any other outcome stops P2.

Test constant `P2_SERVER_FILES = ("zz-pool-settings.xml", "zz-si-access-control.xml", "zz-si-named-collections.xml", "zz-si-replicated-merge-tree.xml", "zz-si-storage.xml")`. `users.d/zz-si-default-loopback.xml` (contract §11) is unchanged.

#### 25.4 charts/storage-integrity values and rendering

All new values are unset or false by default, and with them so every release renders byte-identically:
- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants` (map user → list of engine names, default `{}`): appends `GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON <Engine>` to that user's `grants/query`, one entry per engine, after the user's contract §11 grants, in list order.
- `clickhouse.access.member` (false): renders the `si_member` user and the `si_member` profile (§25.6); needs `clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.si_member`.
- `clickhouse.server.enabled` (false): renders the five files of §25.3 and the reader env.
- `clickhouse.server.keepFreeSpaceBytes` (0; required ≥ 10737418240 when enabled), `clickhouse.server.memberDiskPath` (`/var/lib/clickhouse/disks/member/`), `clickhouse.server.backgroundFetchesPoolSize` (16).
- `clickhouse.server.namedCollections` (list, default `[]`) of `{name, host, port, user, passwordEnv}`; `clickhouse.server.passwordEnv` (list, default `[]`) of `{name, secret: {name, key}}`.
- Helpers in `templates/_helpers.tpl`: `storage-integrity.engineGrants` (the `GRANT TABLE ENGINE` lines of one user), `storage-integrity.memberGrants` (§25.6's list plus the installation's collection grants), `storage-integrity.namedCollectionsXML`.
- The devnet2 overlay `k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml` carries, in the PR, `clickhouse.server` with `enabled: false` and its collections and env already filled for `network`, `clickhouse.access.engineGrants: {}` and `clickhouse.access.member: false`; each live stage commit (§28.2) flips one of them.
- `indexer-b`'s and `indexer-c`'s CHI manifests are never edited in the PR; each live stage commit rewrites the manifest with the runbook helper `si_p2_yaml <installation> <stage>` (§27.2), which takes the network chart's rendering at that stage with the installation's own collections, env, hashes and member disk path, so `test_p2_server_bundle_files_are_identical_across_installations_by_role` holds at every stage.

#### 25.6 The `si_member` user and profile (spec §8.2 as amended; K32/K33; D36)

CHI `users` keys on an installation at its `member` stage: `si_member/password_sha256_hex` (the hash from `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-<installation>.yaml`), `si_member/networks/ip: ["::/0"]`, `si_member/profile: si_member`, `si_member/grants/query`, verbatim and in this order: Plan S3-C2 contract §23.2's `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS`, with one `GRANT NAMED COLLECTION ON <name>` per collection defined on that installation (§25.2 order) in the place §23.2 gives them:
```
GRANT SELECT ON hg_member_unsafe.*
GRANT SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA ON hg_member_unsafe.*
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER DELETE, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE ON hg_replica.*
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, ALTER, CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, TRUNCATE, OPTIMIZE ON hg_rstage.*
GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_replica.*
GRANT CREATE DATABASE ON hg_rstage.*
GRANT READ ON S3
GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON MergeTree
GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON Memory
GRANT SELECT ON system.parts
GRANT SELECT ON system.tables
GRANT SELECT ON system.detached_tables
GRANT SELECT ON system.replicas
GRANT SELECT ON system.zookeeper
GRANT NAMED COLLECTION ON <collection>   (one line per collection of §25.2 defined here)
GRANT READ ON REMOTE
GRANT CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE ON *.*
```
The test constant `SI_MEMBER_GRANTS` holds the sixteen fixed entries; this list equals the one Plan S3-C2 Task 34's confinement suite runs under (§23.2), and a measured difference changes both in one step. The `hg_rstage` entry names its seven rights and is never `ALL` (spec §8.2 as amended in this plans PR, decision D36: no dictionary, view, `SYSTEM` or definer right on `hg_rstage`); Plan S3-C2 §23.2 carries the same entry. CHI `profiles` keys (`SI_MEMBER_PROFILE`; a reload, like the users): `si_member/profile: default` (inherits the default profile), `si_member/max_memory_usage: "4294967296"`, `si_member/max_concurrent_queries_for_user: "8"`, `si_member/max_threads: "4"`, `si_member/priority: "10"`. `si_member_ddl` is never rendered in this plan.

#### 25.7 validate.yaml refusals (verbatim)

- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants requires clickhouse.access.users`
- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants.%s must list ClickHouse table engines by name ([A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]*), never *`
- `clickhouse.access.engineGrants.%s may not hold a Replicated*MergeTree engine: only si_snode and si_verifier create replicated tables`
- `clickhouse.server.enabled requires clickhouse.access.lockDefault: the P2 restart comes after the lockdown (Plan S3-B)`
- `clickhouse.server.enabled requires clickhouse.access.engineGrants for %s: after the restart a user without its engines refuses its own CREATE (spec §8.2)` (every rendered `si_snode`, `si_gateway` and `si_verifier`)
- `clickhouse.server.keepFreeSpaceBytes must be at least 10737418240 (10 GiB)`
- `clickhouse.server.memberDiskPath must be an absolute directory path ending in /`
- `clickhouse.server.backgroundFetchesPoolSize must be an integer from 8 to 64`
- `clickhouse.server.namedCollections[%d] needs name (si_owner_<id> or si_peer_verifier_<n>), host, port, user si_reader and passwordEnv`
- `clickhouse.server.namedCollections[%d].passwordEnv %s has no clickhouse.server.passwordEnv entry`
- `clickhouse.server.passwordEnv[%d] needs name ([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*), secret.name and secret.key`
- `clickhouse.access.member requires clickhouse.server.enabled: no member user exists on a ClickHouse before its restart (spec §8.2)`
- `clickhouse.access.member requires clickhouse.server.namedCollections: si_member pulls only through NOT OVERRIDABLE collections`
- `si_member_ddl is not created before stage 3 P6 step 6 (Plan S3-F)` (any `passwordSha256.si_member_ddl`)
- `clickhouse.access.passwordSha256.%s must be 64 lowercase hex characters` (contract §11, now also for `si_member`)

#### 25.8 Logins script and Secrets

- `scripts/storage-integrity/make-p2-logins.sh <installation> <hashes-file>`, `<installation>` ∈ `network`, `indexer-b`, `indexer-c`, `staging-p2`, run only in the user's terminal. For a member installation it generates the `si_member` password (`openssl rand -hex 24`) and a status token (`openssl rand -hex 32`) and creates two Secrets in namespace `sentio-network-devnet2`: `storage-integrity-si-v2-member-<installation>` with the one key `clickhouse-password`, and the token's own Secret `<release>-si-member-status-token` with the one key `status-token`, where `<release>` is the installation's host release of §25.2 (`sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a-si-member-status-token` for `network`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b-si-member-status-token`, `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-si-member-status-token`; decision D29: the token never shares the Secret that holds the `si_member` password); it writes `passwordSha256:` / `  si_member: <hash>` to `<hashes-file>`. For `staging-p2` it creates Secret `storage-integrity-si-v2-p2-staging-logins` with keys `default`, `si_snode`, `si_gateway`, `si_verifier`, `si_reader`, `si_backup`, `si_member` and writes all seven hashes (no token). It refuses an existing Secret (for a member installation, either of its two) or hashes file, never prints a password or token, and removes its temporary plaintext.
- Mounts (D29): the password Secret only into the `si-member` container (§26.2); the token Secret only within the host's sentio-node release: into the `si-member` container, whose P3 serving listener checks it (Plan S3-C4 §31.3; the P2 image ignores it), and from P3 into the host pod's `sentio-node` container, which presents it (Plan S3-C4 §32.1, `storageIntegrity.replicaReads.memberStatusTokenSecret`); never into `housegate`, a sidecar, a ClickHouse pod or another release. Runbook §1.2 checks with `si_secret_keys` that each member installation's two Secrets hold exactly those keys (key names only, never values).
- Hashes files: `$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-p2-logins/hashes-<installation>.yaml` (directory mode 700; runbook variable `si_p2_logins_dir`, independent of `$si_backup`).

At each installation's `restarted` stage the posture comment of `indexer-b`'s and `indexer-c`'s CHI (contract §11) gains these lines, verbatim, right after its last line, and the network chart's `templates/clickhouse.yaml` carries the same text as a template comment:
```
# Stage 3 P2 (docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p2-members.md): this
# installation restarted once with table_engines_require_grant (every user
# creates only the table engines granted to it by name), keep_free_space_bytes
# on every disk, the disk and storage policy member, the replicated_merge_tree
# merge default 0, background_fetches_pool_size 16 and NOT OVERRIDABLE named
# collections whose si_reader passwords come from the container environment.
# si_member (spec 8.2) exists from this installation's member stage;
# si_member_ddl does not exist before stage 3 P6 step 6. Users, collections,
# files and the environment are installation-wide (Plan S3-C3 K43).
```
